features.raw_text: Bharat Credit Card Sourcing of this Credit Card has been stopped. Existing customers of this card will continue to enjoy the benefits.

Cashback Benefits 5% CashBack every month on spends on PayZapp, EasyEMI, and SmartBuy 5% CashBack every month on ticket bookings via IRCTC. 5% CashBack monthly on fuel, grocery, bill payments, and mobile recharge Combined CashBack is capped at ₹150 per month for the mentioned categories. Recharges with mobile purchases or at mobile outlets aren’t eligible for 5% cashback. No cashback on wallet loading, rent payments, or government transactions. Rewards/cashback eligibility is based on the transaction’s Merchant Category Code. Only eligible MCCs by RuPay for select categories earn 5% rewards. No rewards/cashback on MCCs outside fuel, groceries, IRCTC, and recharges. For detailed terms and conditions, click here. Get up to 10% CashBack on Flight and Hotel bookings, Gift Vouchers and more via SmartBuy.
Fuel Benefits 1% fuel surcharge waiver on minimum transaction of ₹400. Maximum waiver of ₹250 per statement cycle.

Reward Benefits- Link your HDFC Bank Bharat Credit Card on PayZapp. Extra cashback and Reward Points on bill payments and mobile recharge. ₹1,000 CashBack on in-app shopping on 200+ brands. Securely pay without the hassle of OTPs with ‘Swipe to Pay.’

Single Interface One unified platform for Credit Cards, Debit Cards, Fastag and Consumer Durable Loans Spends tracking Simple interface to track all your spends Reward Points View and redeem points at the push of a button

1 Reward Point = ₹1 CashBack will be credited as reward points in the next statement. Redemption of cashback against the statement balance is available on request. Unredeemed reward points expire after 2 years of accumulation. With effect from 1st February 2023, Reward Points redemption is capped at 3,000 points per month. Redeem up to 70% of product/voucher value with points; pay the rest via Credit Card. Click here for further details on the process to redeem Reward Points.

Revolving Credit is available at a nominal interest rate. (Check the fees and charges section for more details). Get Up to 50 days of interest-free credit from the date of purchase. The offer is subject to the submission of the charge by the merchant. Stay protected against unauthorised use when you shop anywhere with EMV Chip Card technology.

Joining / Renewal Membership Fee – Rs. 500/- Plus Applicable Taxes To view all the fees and charges applicable on your Bharat Credit Card, go to 'Manage Your Credit Cards -> Personal MITC' Goods and Services Tax (GST) Effective 1st July 2017 Service Tax , KKC & SBC of 15% is replaced by Goods&Service Tax (GST) at 18% The applicable GST would be dependent on place of provision (POP) and place of supply (POS).If POP and POS is in the same state then applicable GST Would be CGST and SGST/UTGST else, IGST. GST For FEE & Charges / Interest transactions Billed on statement date will reflect in next month statement. GST levied will not be reversed on Any dispute on Fee & Charges / interest. For card sourced effective 01-11- 2020, Below T&Cs are applicable Note*: The Bank reserves the right to cancel the Card in case the Card remains inactive and is not used for effecting any transaction for a continuous period of 6 (Six) months after prior written notice sent on the email address and/or phone number and/or communication address, registered in the records of the Bank. Click here to know more Fees & Charges

You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. evidence_data.value: Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. IVR To enable or modify your HDFC Bank Credit Card controls and transaction limits, you can contact HDFC Bank's toll-free numbers: Toll-free numbers: 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available from 8 am to 8 pm) For overseas travel assistance: 022-61606160 By contacting our toll-free numbers, you can enable/modify limits for Domestic, International, Online, Contactless, ATM, and POS transactions on your Debit or Credit Card.

Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. Cardholders typically incur an annual fee/renewal membership of ₹1000+ GST, giving access to the exclusive features and rewards associated with this Credit Card. CashBack Benefits Get 3 Reward Points for every ₹200 you spend Redeem Reward Points for air miles on more than 20 international airlines or on any major domestic airline. Redeem your Reward Points for exciting gifts from an exclusive rewards catalogue, at the applicable redemption rate.

Lifestyle Benefits Enjoy 50% more reward points* when you dine out. 1% fuel surcharge waiver at all fuel stations across India on transaction between ₹ 400 and ₹ 5,000. Max waiver of ₹ 250 per statement cycle.
Rewards Benefits Get 1,000 Reward Points on Joining Earn 1,000 Reward Points Every Year

Insurance Benefits Protection worth up to ₹ 20 Lakh* against costs arising due to professional negligence. Bodily injury and / or death of any patient caused by error, omission or negligence in professional service rendered Legal costs and Defence expenses on *any one accident up to ₹ 4 Lakh & Deductible ₹ 25,000 for each & every claim Note: This benefit is applicable w.e.f. 1st Sept'19 only. For more details on policy, Click here

Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. IVR To enable or modify your HDFC Bank Credit Card controls and transaction limits, you can contact HDFC Bank's toll-free numbers: Toll-free numbers: 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available from 8 am to 8 pm) For overseas travel assistance: 022-61606160 By contacting our toll-free numbers, you can enable/modify limits for Domestic, International, Online, Contactless, ATM, and POS transactions on your Debit or Credit Card.

Zero Lost card liability If you lose your Card, report it immediately to 24-hour call centre. After reporting the loss, you have zero liability on any fraudulent transactions made with your card. Revolving Credit Enjoy Revolving Credit on your Credit Card at nominal interest rate, refer Fees and Charges section. Interest free credit Avail up to 50 interest free days from the date of purchase (subject to the submission of the charge by the Merchant).

Your HDFC Bank Doctor’s Superia Credit Card gives you tons of reasons to dine out. Enjoy 50% more reward points* when you dine. Now every meal will be more rewarding. *50% more Reward Points are offered to the Cardholders only on those transactions which are classified under the 'Restaurant' Merchant Category Code (MCC) as defined by VISA/ MasterCard. Merchant Category Code (MCC) classified under 'Hotel' categories will not qualify for 50% more Reward Points.

Redemption Accumulate Reward Points and redeem them for air miles on more than 20 international airlines or on any major domestic airline. (100 AirMiles = 667 Reward Points) You can also redeem your Reward Points for exciting gifts from an exclusive rewards catalogue, at the applicable redemption rate. Please click here for further details. Only retail purchases qualify for Reward Points. Cash advance, fees and other charges do not accrue any reward points. Transaction amounts less than ₹ 200 will not accrue any Reward Points. Reward points validity Reward points are valid only for 2 years from the date of accumulation. For example: if you receive reward points in May 2015, same will expire in May 2017.

Joining / Annual membership Fee: ₹1,000 Please click here to view the fees and charges applicable on your Doctor's Superia Credit Card. Goods and Services Tax (GST) Effective 1st July 2017 Service Tax, KKC & SBC of 15% is replaced by Goods & Service Tax (GST) at 18% The applicable GST would be dependent on place of provision (POP) and place of supply (POS). If POP and POS (Point of Sale) is in the same state then applicable GST would be CGST and SGST/UTGST else, IGST. GST For FEE & Charges / Interest transactions Billed on statement date will reflect in next month statement. GST levied will not be reversed on Any dispute on Fee & Charges / interest.

Apply for a Credit Card online in 3 simple steps: Step 1 - Provide your personal details Step 2 - Select the Credit Card best suited for you Step 3 - Upload your documents and submit More About The Card Credit Card Management & Controls Card Reward & Redemption Program Cashback Validity Contactless Payment Smart EMI Zero Cost Card Liability Revolving Credit Most Important Terms and Conditions Credit Card Management & Controls Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. Apply for a Credit Card online in 3 simple steps: Step 1 - Provide your personal details Step 2 - Select the Credit Card best suited for you Step 3 - Upload your documents and submit More About The Card Credit Card Management & Controls Card Reward & Redemption Program Cashback Validity Contactless Payment Smart EMI Zero Cost Card Liability Revolving Credit Most Important Terms and Conditions Credit Card Management & Controls Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. evidence_data.value: Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. IVR To enable or modify your HDFC Bank Credit Card controls and transaction limits, you can contact HDFC Bank's toll-free numbers: Toll-free numbers: 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available from 8 am to 8 pm) For overseas travel assistance: 022-61606160 By contacting our toll-free numbers, you can enable/modify limits for Domestic, International, Online, Contactless, ATM, and POS transactions on your Debit or Credit Card.

Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Check Eligibility Know more about the card Credit Card Management & Controls Fee and Charges Redemption Value Contactless Payment Most Important Terms and Conditions Application Channels Credit Card Management & Controls Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. evidence_data.value: Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. IVR To enable or modify your HDFC Bank Credit Card controls and transaction limits, you can contact HDFC Bank's toll-free numbers: Toll-free numbers: 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available from 8 am to 8 pm) For overseas travel assistance: 022-61606160 By contacting our toll-free numbers, you can enable/modify limits for Domestic, International, Online, Contactless, ATM, and POS transactions on your Debit or Credit Card.

I bought items from Amazon which along included vegetable oil as well. Why didn’t I get 5% FP on this transaction? Eligibility for Fuel Points on transaction is basis the Merchant Category Code (MCC) captured for the transaction. Only those MCCs recognized and considered by Partner Networks (Visa/RuPay) for the above mentioned categories will accrue 5% Fuel Points (FP). If your transaction didn’t accrue any FP, it is because it is not recognized as Fuel/Groceries/Utilities/Bill Payment as per standard Merchant Category Code Should I register for XTRAREWARDSTM Program? If so, how to I enroll myself for it? IndianOil HDFC Bank Credit Cardholders are automatically and mandatorily registered with IndianOil XTRAREWARDSTM Program during the time of Credit Card issuance. Once the Customer is automatically registered, you will receive an SMS on your registered mobile number from IndianOil, with the confirmation of your XTRAREWARDSTM Program account successfully been created along with an XTRAREWARDSTM Customer ID (XR CID). In case you haven’t received the confirmation SMS within 5 business days of receiving your Credit Card, please connect with the Bank for resolution. Post creation of your XR CID, you could also install “IndianOil ONE” App from Android Play Store or IOS App store (Not mandatory) to help keep track of your XRP Balance and Transactions Note: XR CID is created by Indian Oil for the purpose of redeeming points against free fuel. This is different from the Customer ID maintained with the Bank. Can I make partial payments using XTRAREWARD POINTSTM? Yes, Post verifying that the IndianOil Retail outlet is a Participating Outlet, check with the Merchant on Payment option using XTRAREWARDTM POINT. Redemption process flow is mentioned in Q2. If you are unable to pay your fuel bill entirely through XTRAREWARDTM POINTS (XRP), Then you can partially pay through XRP and partially through your IndianOil HDFC Bank Credit Card. What If I wish to cancel my membership with IndianOil XTRAREWARDS Program? Having Customer ID with XTRAREWARDS Program is necessary since without this membership, you cannot convert Fuel Points accrued on your credit card into XTRAREWARDTM POINTS and use them at IndianOil Fuel Outlets for free fuel redemption. Also, having this XR CID is critical to receive information or any status update on your XTRAREWARDSTM Program account with IndianOil. Can I get Fuel Point on all spends? Fuel Points can be accrued on all kinds of Retail Spends that include both Online and Point of Sale (PoS) transactions. However, there are few kinds of transactions for which you will not get Fuel Points. They are: Fuel transactions at other petrol pumps Any kind of wallet-loading On Returned purchases, disputed or unauthorized/fraudulent transactions EMI Transactions Account Fees and Payment Purchase of jewellery/gold coins or its equivalents I have spent more than Rs. 5000 on Petrol/Diesel/CNG in a calendar month. However, why I received only 150 FP. Why? Please Note that there is a monthly capping on Fuel Points accrued on the below mentioned spends. Spends at IndianOil Outlets – - Monthly Max cap for the first 6 months from card issuance: 250 FP - Monthly Max cap post 6 months: 150 FP Spends on Groceries – Monthly Max cap: 100 FP Spends on Utilities and Bill Payments – Monthly Max cap: 100 FP What are the benefits of a Fuel Credit Card? Fuel Credit Cards, like the Indian Oil Credit Card, offer fuel surcharge waivers, reward points on fuel spends, and free fuel accumulation for savings on fuel and utility bills. What is the Cashback of the IndianOil Credit Card? What is the CashBack offered by the IndianOil Credit Card? Indian Oil Credit Card provides CashBack in the form of reward points, redeemable for free fuel or other options. Details are in the card's terms. How do I check my balance Fuel Points? Fuel Points accrued on all eligible transactions posted within the calendar month will be added up and credited on the 1st of the next calendar month. Please note that maximum capping will be applied before crediting them. A. You can check the Fuel Points accrued for the previous calendar month’s transactions posted on the current month statement shared with you (Physical or E-statement) B. You can also check by Logging into: NetBanking -> Cards Tab -> Click on “Enquiry” -> Reward Points Redemption -> Choose your IndianOil HDFC Bank Credit Card Number -> View total Fuel Points accrued Can I Use the IndianOil Credit Card for Shopping? Yes, you can use it for shopping, offering benefits not only on fuel but also rewards or cashback on other transactions. IndianOil XTRAREWARDSTM PROGRAM is an exclusive Loyalty Rewards Program owned and run by Indian Oil Corporation Ltd. This Loyalty program rewards the customers enrolled with them by awarding XTRAREWARDTM Points (XRP) on every transaction at any IndianOil Retail Outlet and also allowing the Customer to redeem these accrued Points at participating IndianOil Retail Outlet for free fuel. For more details on this program, visit, https://www.xtrarewards.com IndianOil HDFC Bank Credit Cardholders will get this Membership automatically and for free along with their credit cards. Your Membership will stay valid even after close of this Card or upgrade/migration to another HDFC Bank Credit Card. However, you will no longer be able to convert Fuel Points to XTRAREWARD Points for Fuel Redemption. What is the Eligibility for an Indian Oil Credit Card? I bought items from Amazon which along included vegetable oil as well. Why didn’t I get 5% FP on this transaction? Eligibility for Fuel Points on transaction is basis the Merchant Category Code (MCC) captured for the transaction. Only those MCCs recognized and considered by Partner Networks (Visa/RuPay) for the above mentioned categories will accrue 5% Fuel Points (FP). If your transaction didn’t accrue any FP, it is because it is not recognized as Fuel/Groceries/Utilities/Bill Payment as per standard Merchant Category Code Should I register for XTRAREWARDSTM Program? If so, how to I enroll myself for it? IndianOil HDFC Bank Credit Cardholders are automatically and mandatorily registered with IndianOil XTRAREWARDSTM Program during the time of Credit Card issuance. Once the Customer is automatically registered, you will receive an SMS on your registered mobile number from IndianOil, with the confirmation of your XTRAREWARDSTM Program account successfully been created along with an XTRAREWARDSTM Customer ID (XR CID). In case you haven’t received the confirmation SMS within 5 business days of receiving your Credit Card, please connect with the Bank for resolution. Post creation of your XR CID, you could also install “IndianOil ONE” App from Android Play Store or IOS App store (Not mandatory) to help keep track of your XRP Balance and Transactions Note: XR CID is created by Indian Oil for the purpose of redeeming points against free fuel. This is different from the Customer ID maintained with the Bank. Can I make partial payments using XTRAREWARD POINTSTM? Yes, Post verifying that the IndianOil Retail outlet is a Participating Outlet, check with the Merchant on Payment option using XTRAREWARDTM POINT. Redemption process flow is mentioned in Q2. If you are unable to pay your fuel bill entirely through XTRAREWARDTM POINTS (XRP), Then you can partially pay through XRP and partially through your IndianOil HDFC Bank Credit Card. What If I wish to cancel my membership with IndianOil XTRAREWARDS Program? Having Customer ID with XTRAREWARDS Program is necessary since without this membership, you cannot convert Fuel Points accrued on your credit card into XTRAREWARDTM POINTS and use them at IndianOil Fuel Outlets for free fuel redemption. Also, having this XR CID is critical to receive information or any status update on your XTRAREWARDSTM Program account with IndianOil. Can I get Fuel Point on all spends? Fuel Points can be accrued on all kinds of Retail Spends that include both Online and Point of Sale (PoS) transactions. However, there are few kinds of transactions for which you will not get Fuel Points. They are: Fuel transactions at other petrol pumps Any kind of wallet-loading On Returned purchases, disputed or unauthorized/fraudulent transactions EMI Transactions Account Fees and Payment Purchase of jewellery/gold coins or its equivalents I have spent more than Rs. 5000 on Petrol/Diesel/CNG in a calendar month. However, why I received only 150 FP. Why? Please Note that there is a monthly capping on Fuel Points accrued on the below mentioned spends. Spends at IndianOil Outlets – - Monthly Max cap for the first 6 months from card issuance: 250 FP - Monthly Max cap post 6 months: 150 FP Spends on Groceries – Monthly Max cap: 100 FP Spends on Utilities and Bill Payments – Monthly Max cap: 100 FP What are the benefits of a Fuel Credit Card? Fuel Credit Cards, like the Indian Oil Credit Card, offer fuel surcharge waivers, reward points on fuel spends, and free fuel accumulation for savings on fuel and utility bills. What is the Cashback of the IndianOil Credit Card? What is the CashBack offered by the IndianOil Credit Card? Indian Oil Credit Card provides CashBack in the form of reward points, redeemable for free fuel or other options. Details are in the card's terms. How do I check my balance Fuel Points? Fuel Points accrued on all eligible transactions posted within the calendar month will be added up and credited on the 1st of the next calendar month. Please note that maximum capping will be applied before crediting them. A. You can check the Fuel Points accrued for the previous calendar month’s transactions posted on the current month statement shared with you (Physical or E-statement) B. You can also check by Logging into: NetBanking -> Cards Tab -> Click on “Enquiry” -> Reward Points Redemption -> Choose your IndianOil HDFC Bank Credit Card Number -> View total Fuel Points accrued Can I Use the IndianOil Credit Card for Shopping? Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Metal Credit Cards are premium Credit Cards which are highly exclusive, usually available by invite only. HDFC Bank’s Infinia Metal Credit Card is available in a metallic version with many unique benefits. To get this card, you need an invitation. As a welcome benefit, you get 12,500 Reward Points upon fee realisation and card activation. Who is eligible for an Infinia Metal Credit Card? HDFC Bank Infinia Metal Credit Card is offered to select customers by invitation only. The Bank will assess your eligibility and inform you personally if you qualify for the card. Is the Infinia Metal Credit Card free? No, the Infinia Metal Credit Card is not free. There is a joining fee of ₹12,500 plus applicable taxes and an annual renewal fee of ₹12,500 plus applicable taxes. What are the advantages of having an Infinia Metal Credit Card? The card offers a wide range of benefits: Stylish metal edition Credit Card 5 Reward Points per ₹150 spent Complimentary Club Marriott membership for the first year and 12,500 Reward Points upon fee realisation and card activation On spending ₹10 lakh or more in the preceding 12 months, get a renewal fee waiver in the next year Unlimited airport lounge access How to Apply for a Metal Credit Card? A membership to Marriott Hotels in India and Asia-Pacific region that provides benefits to members on presentation of the Club Marriott Membership Card. The benefits include: Up to 25% off on the food and beverage bill at participating restaurants. Up to 20% off on the Best Available Rate on rooms at participating Marriott hotels in India and Asia Pacific. 20% off on Spa services at select participating Marriott managed spas in India. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Metal Credit Cards are premium Credit Cards which are highly exclusive, usually available by invite only. HDFC Bank’s Infinia Metal Credit Card is available in a metallic version with many unique benefits. To get this card, you need an invitation. As a welcome benefit, you get 12,500 Reward Points upon fee realisation and card activation. Who is eligible for an Infinia Metal Credit Card? HDFC Bank Infinia Metal Credit Card is offered to select customers by invitation only. The Bank will assess your eligibility and inform you personally if you qualify for the card. Is the Infinia Metal Credit Card free? No, the Infinia Metal Credit Card is not free. There is a joining fee of ₹12,500 plus applicable taxes and an annual renewal fee of ₹12,500 plus applicable taxes. What are the advantages of having an Infinia Metal Credit Card? The card offers a wide range of benefits: Stylish metal edition Credit Card 5 Reward Points per ₹150 spent Complimentary Club Marriott membership for the first year and 12,500 Reward Points upon fee realisation and card activation On spending ₹10 lakh or more in the preceding 12 months, get a renewal fee waiver in the next year Unlimited airport lounge access How to Apply for a Metal Credit Card? Membership to this card is available by invitation only. What is Club Marriott Membership? A membership to Marriott Hotels in India and Asia-Pacific region that provides benefits to members on presentation of the Club Marriott Membership Card. The benefits include: Up to 25% off on the food and beverage bill at participating restaurants. Up to 20% off on the Best Available Rate on rooms at participating Marriott hotels in India and Asia Pacific. 20% off on Spa services at select participating Marriott managed spas in India.
