Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. evidence_data.value: Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. The IRCTC Credit Card, specifically the HDFC Bank IRCTC Credit Card, is a specialised Credit Card designed in collaboration with the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC). This card offers a range of benefits, including reward points, CashBack, travel perks, IRCTC executive lounge access, and more making it an ideal choice for frequent train travellers. What are the documents required to apply for an IRCTC Credit Card? (Need more clarity on the documents required) Documents required for the HDFC Bank IRCTC Credit Card include: Identity Proof Passport Aadhaar Card Voter ID Driving licence PAN card Passport size photos Address Proof Utility bills (electricity, water, gas, or telephone) Rental agreement Passport Aadhaar card Voter ID Income Proof Salary slips (for salaried individuals) Income Tax Returns (ITR) Form 16 Bank statements What is the are the travel offer benefits offered by IRCTC on the IRCTC Credit Card? The IRCTC Credit Card offers several travel benefits: 5 Reward Points for every ₹100 spent on the IRCTC ticketing website and the Rail Connect app. Additional 5% cashback on train ticket bookings via HDFC Bank SmartBuy. 8 complimentary access passes to select IRCTC executive lounges every year. 1% transaction charges waiver on transactions done on the IRCTC ticketing website and Rail Connect app. Can I withdraw money from the IRCTC Credit Card? Yes, you can withdraw cash using your IRCTC Credit Card, However, the bank will charge a cash advance fee of 2.5% of the transaction amount or a minimum of ₹500 whichever is higher. The bank also offers a cash advance limit of 40%. The type of your Credit Card ascertains your cash advance limit. Can I use the IRCTC Credit Card for international transactions? While the IRCTC Credit Card is primarily designed for domestic use, it may be accepted for international transactions. However, it's crucial to check with the issuing bank to confirm the card's international validity. Keep in mind that international transactions may attract additional charges, including currency conversion fees. What is the use of IRCTC Credit Card? The IRCTC Credit Card offers various benefits like reward points, cashback, lounge access, and transaction charge waivers. It can be used for making purchases on the IRCTC website and the Rail Connect app, earning reward points on every transaction. Additionally, the card offers cashback on various other expenses, fuel surcharge waivers, and access to exclusive lounges. How to apply for the IRCTC Credit Card? To apply for the IRCTC Credit Card, follow these general steps: Visit the official website of the HDFC Bank. Navigate to the credit card section and find the IRCTC Credit Card. Fill out the online application form with the required personal and financial details and documents. Submit the application and await approval from the bank. Once approved, the bank will dispatch the credit card to your registered address. What are the key features of the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? 5 Reward Point per ₹100 spent on IRCTC Ticketing Website/ Rail Connect App 1 Reward Point per ₹100 spent on all other merchant (Spends on EMI interest amount and repayment, Fuel, Wallet load, gift vouchers, prepaid card loading, cash advances, payment of outstanding balances, payment of card fee and other charges, Government charges, Education, rental transactions etc. are excluded). Additional 5% CashBack on Train ticket booking via HDFC Bank SmartBuy. Value of 1 RP= ₹1 for Train ticket booking Gift Voucher Worth ₹500 on first transaction within 37 days of card issuance. Gift Voucher worth ₹500 on quarterly spends of ₹30,000. Reversal of 1% Transaction charges on transactions done on IRCTC Ticketing Website and Rail Connect 8 Complimentary access to select IRCTC Executive Lounges every year (Max 2 per quarter) What are the Fees and Charges applicable on IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? First Year Joining Fee – ₹500/- + Applicable Taxes Renewal Membership Fee – ₹500/- + Applicable Taxes Can my Joining fee or Card renewal fee be waived off? Renewal fee can be waived off if a customer spends ₹1,50,000 or more in an anniversary year, before your Credit Card renewal date. What are the other benefits on of the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? 1% Fuel Surcharge waiver on fuel transactions (Minimum transaction of ₹400, Maximum transaction of ₹5,000 & Maximum CashBack of ₹250 per statement cycle) (Fuel surcharge varies from 1% to 2.5% of fuel transaction base amount. The rate of surcharge may vary depending on the fuel station and their acquiring bank. GST is as applicable and is not reversible.) How can I apply for IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? You can apply for this Credit Card through both online and offline modes. To apply online, you can visit the official website of HDFC Bank - http://www.hdfcbank.com or you can visit the official website of IRCTC – https://irctc.co.in To apply offline, you may visit the nearest branch of the bank to fill out the application form. How can I get my Welcome gift voucher? Customer will be eligible for a gift voucher worth Rs.₹500 on performing 1 transaction of any amount within the first 37 days from card issuance date. Activation vouchers will be issued to customers within 90 working days after the end of card issuance month. Bank will share the voucher code to customer via SMS/Email. Customers need to claim the voucher by visiting the link given in the Eligibility Mailer, or by sending an SMS according to the short codes given in the eligibility SMS. E-Vouchers will be triggered immediately to the customers on receipt of the-voucher choice. Post verification of voucher code the redeemed amount will be credited to cardholders e-wallet balance Customer can also book the ticket by using wallet balance. How many reward points will be earned if a cardholder spends through HDFC Bank SmartBuy? A cardholder will be eligible for an additional 5% CashBack + 5% as HDFC Bank Reward points as per product feature if he/she does a transaction through HDFC Bank SmartBuy on IRCTC. All other existing SmartBuy offers will be applicable as per SmartBuy Terms & Conditions. What is the loyalty number printed on the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? The loyalty number printed on the back of your IRCTC HDFC Bank Card plastic is a an 11-digit number which gets allocated on approval of the card application. Cardholder shall avail the benefits of the IRCTC HDFC Bank Card by linking the IRCTC HDFC Bank Card loyalty number to his/her existing IRCTC login id. How to link your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card loyalty number with your IRCTC login? You can link your 11 digits loyalty number post joining fee payment of your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card. You need to use the same email id, mobile no. and date of birth that was mentioned while applying for the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card. Steps for linking the loyalty number with IRCTC login id are mentioned below: Visit IRCTC Ticketing Website/Rail Connect App and access the IRCTC account with your existing login id (Username and password). In case you do not have an existing login id on IRCTC Ticketing Website then you would need to register yourself by signing up at IRCTC. Select the option- “Add Loyalty Account “link provided under Loyalty Account Tab. Enter the 11 digits Loyalty Number printed at the back of your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card, then click on sent OTP. Enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number and click on Confirm. After entering the OTP, cardholder will receive confirmation message of successful linking of Loyalty Account. You can check your Loyalty Account details under the “Loyalty Account tab”. You will not be able to link your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card if there is a mismatch in the email id, mobile no. and date of birth that was mentioned while applying for the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card. You can call on IRCTC customer care on 14646 or 0755-6610661/0755-4090600 if you are unable to link your IRCTC HDFC Bank Card loyalty number with your IRCTC login ID and password. Can I withdraw cash through IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? Yes, you can withdraw cash via this Credit Card through any ATM. However, the Bank will charge a cash advance fee of 2.5% of the transaction amount or a minimum of RS. ₹500 whichever is higher. At HDFC Bank, we offer a cash advance limit of 40 %. So, if your Credit Card limit is Rs ₹1 lakh, you can withdraw cash up to Rs ₹40,000. The type of your Credit Card ascertains your cash advance limit. What should I do if my card is lost or damaged? If your Credit Card is lost or stolen, you should immediately inform the Bank by visiting the nearest branch or by calling on the customer care number. Alternatively, login to HDFC Bank Online at once and report your lost or stolen card in the service requests section in the menu. How can I check the status of my credit card application? You can check the status of your Credit Card application by visiting the official website of the Bank. On the homepage, under the cards section, you will find an option of to ‘Track your Application’. You will be asked for an Application Reference Number (ARN), post which the Bank will be able to tell you the status of your Credit Card application. Below is the link available for application tracking https://www.hdfcbank.com/personal/pay/cards/credit-cards/track-your-credit-card What are the Reward Points? "Reward Points” shall mean the points earned by the Rewards Program members, for undertaking such transactions and activities as specified under the Rewards Program, which may be redeemed towards purchase of railway tickets and/ or other services on the Platform and/ or through any other redemption options/ on other platforms mutually agreed upon by the Parties. What is the validity for reward points? Reward points are valid for 2 years When will the earned Reward Points be posted in the cardholder statement? The total Reward points earned in a cycle will reflect in the subsequent month statement of the cardholder How can I check my reward point balance? Steps to check your Reward Points balance through NetBanking You can check your reward point balance in your NetBanking account. You need to login to your HDFC Bank NetBanking account Then go to Cards and click on Request Select your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card number Now select “Rewards” and you will be able to see your rewards balance. Steps to check your Reward Points balance through SmartBuy Login to your HDFC Bank SmartBuy account. Click on the “Unlock Reward Summary” tab would appear on the top right corner of your screen. You would need to input your mobile number registered with HDFC Bank, Last four digit of your Credit Card and your date of birth. You would be able to see your reward point balance once the details provided by you is are verified. How do I redeem these Points? You can use your HDFC Bank Reward Points for train ticket booking via SmartBuy Steps to redeem Reward Points from HDFC Bank SmartBuy: To redeem the Reward points, the customer needs to visit HDFC Bank SmartBuy Platform. https://offers.smartbuy.hdfcbank.com/v1/foryou Inside HDFC Bank SmartBuy platform, the customer can select IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card under Privileges. Either a customer can login after entering landing to the IRCTC HDFC Bank Card or customer can login later once prompted while trying to book the train ticket. To book the train ticket enter source station, destination, date of journey and submit the information Check the class of travel, click on the preferred train and check the seat availability for the proposed date(s). Enter your IRCTC Authorised Partner user ID or create an IRCTC Authorised Partner account if you don’t have one already. Submit the traveller’s details. Pay with Points + Pay or Pay option from IRCTC Co Brand Card. At payment gateway, the customer can see option to pay with Points + Pay with Credit Card or Pay with Credit Card. On the next payment page, the customer can see the Reward Point Slider that they can use to add the number of reward points for redemption Redemption can be made only against a maximum of 70% of fare ticket amount on train ticket booking via HDFC Bank SmartBuy, inclusive of fares of all the passengers and service charges levied by IRCTC. Is there any Reward Redemption charge? Yes. On successful points redemption HDFC Bank Credit Card will be charged Rs.₹99 + GST on the Credit Card. But this could change subject to HDFC Bank’s terms and conditions. Please read our terms and conditions regularly for any changes, if applicable. Do I need minimum points to redeem? Yes, you would need a minimum of 100 points to redeem. Is there any limit to redeem points? Yes, you can redeem up to a maximum of 70% of booking value through Reward Points. Rest will have to be paid via Credit Card. What if I don’t have enough Points to redeem? You can choose to pay partially using the reward points and the balance payment through your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card. Please remember that you would need a minimum 100 points to redeem. But, if you do not have enough reward points to redeem you can continue to pay full amount through IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card. Is IRCTC Executive lounge access available on IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? Customer can enjoy 8 Complimentary IRCTC Executive Lounge access per year (2 per quarter) ₹ 2/- will be charged from the customer’s account to validate the card for complimentary lounge access. This amount will be non-refundable. What facilities do I get in the IRCTC Executive Lounge? The complimentary access to IRCTC Executive Lounge will include the below facilities: Two Hours of lounge stay A/C comfortable sitting arrangements Access to washrooms / changing room 1 Buffet meal- Breakfast, Lunch or Dinner as per the time of visit. Unlimited tea & coffee Free Wi-Fi Charging points Newspaper and Magazine Any additional service such as recliners or more shall be chargeable separate as per the operator price for that service. How does a cardholder calculate Reward points earned on monthly spends? Reward Points are calculated on the spends made within the calendar month cycle. Only settled transactions within the calendar month will be considered for Reward Points posting. For example: Cardholder statement is received on every 18th of the month. The Reward Points accrued for cardholder transactions from 1st of January till 31st of January will be calculated and posted on the 1st of February and the same can be seen when cardholder the receives the statement on 18th of February. How can I check my eligibility for this card? Individuals above the age of 21 years can apply for the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card. Based on the Bank’s internal Policy, the potential customer will be given the card. Are reward points transferable? No, the reward points are not transferable and cannot be combined with the points accrued on any other HDFC Bank card account. What happens if a cardholder exceeded exceeds the quarterly complimentary IRCTC Executive Lounge visits on IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card ? All the visits exceeding the complimentary quarterly quota will be allowed at the discretion of lounge and will also be chargeable by the IRCTC Executive Lounge. As a Cardholder I am not getting Reward Points on spends, why so? Reward Points shall not be eligible for the following spends/transactions on the card, Fuel Spends Wallet loads / Gift or Prepaid Card load/ Voucher purchase Cash Advances Payment of Outstanding Balances Payment of card fees and other charges Government related transactions Education Smart EMI / Dial an EMI transaction Rental transactions Interest amount of Merchant EMI If a cardholder breaches the monthly cycle capping of the product feature, then Reward Points shall not be rewarded for the spends made beyond the monthly capping. Is there any capping for Cashback earned on IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card Features? Please note that there is a calendar month capping on Reward Points accrued on the below mentioned features The accrual of the 5 HDFC Bank Reward points on IRCTC spends is capped maximum at 1,000 Reward Points per month and 12,000 Reward points Annually. The accrual of the additional 5% cashback on Train Ticket Booking via HDFC BANK SmartBuy is capped maximum at ₹1,000 per month and ₹12,000 Reward points Annually. As a cardholder, I have not received my reward points for tickets booked through IRCTC Ticketing Website/ Rail Connect App? If a cardholder breaches the monthly cycle capping of the product feature of 1,000 Reward Points, then Reward Points shall not be rewarded for the spends done beyond the monthly capping. If the cardholder has not met the monthly cycle capping then the customer should contact the HDFC Bank Credit Card Customer Care. View More Travel. Earn. The IRCTC Credit Card, specifically the HDFC Bank IRCTC Credit Card, is a specialised Credit Card designed in collaboration with the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC). This card offers a range of benefits, including reward points, CashBack, travel perks, IRCTC executive lounge access, and more making it an ideal choice for frequent train travellers. What are the documents required to apply for an IRCTC Credit Card? (Need more clarity on the documents required) Documents required for the HDFC Bank IRCTC Credit Card include: Identity Proof Passport Aadhaar Card Voter ID Driving licence PAN card Passport size photos Address Proof Utility bills (electricity, water, gas, or telephone) Rental agreement Passport Aadhaar card Voter ID Income Proof Salary slips (for salaried individuals) Income Tax Returns (ITR) Form 16 Bank statements What is the are the travel offer benefits offered by IRCTC on the IRCTC Credit Card? The IRCTC Credit Card offers several travel benefits: 5 Reward Points for every ₹100 spent on the IRCTC ticketing website and the Rail Connect app. Additional 5% cashback on train ticket bookings via HDFC Bank SmartBuy. 8 complimentary access passes to select IRCTC executive lounges every year. 1% transaction charges waiver on transactions done on the IRCTC ticketing website and Rail Connect app. Can I withdraw money from the IRCTC Credit Card? Yes, you can withdraw cash using your IRCTC Credit Card, However, the bank will charge a cash advance fee of 2.5% of the transaction amount or a minimum of ₹500 whichever is higher. The bank also offers a cash advance limit of 40%. The type of your Credit Card ascertains your cash advance limit. Can I use the IRCTC Credit Card for international transactions? While the IRCTC Credit Card is primarily designed for domestic use, it may be accepted for international transactions. However, it's crucial to check with the issuing bank to confirm the card's international validity. Keep in mind that international transactions may attract additional charges, including currency conversion fees. What is the use of IRCTC Credit Card? The IRCTC Credit Card offers various benefits like reward points, cashback, lounge access, and transaction charge waivers. It can be used for making purchases on the IRCTC website and the Rail Connect app, earning reward points on every transaction. Additionally, the card offers cashback on various other expenses, fuel surcharge waivers, and access to exclusive lounges. How to apply for the IRCTC Credit Card? To apply for the IRCTC Credit Card, follow these general steps: Visit the official website of the HDFC Bank. Navigate to the credit card section and find the IRCTC Credit Card. Fill out the online application form with the required personal and financial details and documents. Submit the application and await approval from the bank. Once approved, the bank will dispatch the credit card to your registered address. What are the key features of the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? 5 Reward Point per ₹100 spent on IRCTC Ticketing Website/ Rail Connect App 1 Reward Point per ₹100 spent on all other merchant (Spends on EMI interest amount and repayment, Fuel, Wallet load, gift vouchers, prepaid card loading, cash advances, payment of outstanding balances, payment of card fee and other charges, Government charges, Education, rental transactions etc. are excluded). Additional 5% CashBack on Train ticket booking via HDFC Bank SmartBuy. Value of 1 RP= ₹1 for Train ticket booking Gift Voucher Worth ₹500 on first transaction within 37 days of card issuance. Gift Voucher worth ₹500 on quarterly spends of ₹30,000. Reversal of 1% Transaction charges on transactions done on IRCTC Ticketing Website and Rail Connect 8 Complimentary access to select IRCTC Executive Lounges every year (Max 2 per quarter) What are the Fees and Charges applicable on IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? First Year Joining Fee – ₹500/- + Applicable Taxes Renewal Membership Fee – ₹500/- + Applicable Taxes Can my Joining fee or Card renewal fee be waived off? Renewal fee can be waived off if a customer spends ₹1,50,000 or more in an anniversary year, before your Credit Card renewal date. What are the other benefits on of the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? 1% Fuel Surcharge waiver on fuel transactions (Minimum transaction of ₹400, Maximum transaction of ₹5,000 & Maximum CashBack of ₹250 per statement cycle) (Fuel surcharge varies from 1% to 2.5% of fuel transaction base amount. The rate of surcharge may vary depending on the fuel station and their acquiring bank. GST is as applicable and is not reversible.) How can I apply for IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? You can apply for this Credit Card through both online and offline modes. To apply online, you can visit the official website of HDFC Bank - http://www.hdfcbank.com or you can visit the official website of IRCTC – https://irctc.co.in To apply offline, you may visit the nearest branch of the bank to fill out the application form. How can I get my Welcome gift voucher? Customer will be eligible for a gift voucher worth Rs.₹500 on performing 1 transaction of any amount within the first 37 days from card issuance date. Activation vouchers will be issued to customers within 90 working days after the end of card issuance month. Bank will share the voucher code to customer via SMS/Email. Customers need to claim the voucher by visiting the link given in the Eligibility Mailer, or by sending an SMS according to the short codes given in the eligibility SMS. E-Vouchers will be triggered immediately to the customers on receipt of the-voucher choice. Post verification of voucher code the redeemed amount will be credited to cardholders e-wallet balance Customer can also book the ticket by using wallet balance. How many reward points will be earned if a cardholder spends through HDFC Bank SmartBuy? A cardholder will be eligible for an additional 5% CashBack + 5% as HDFC Bank Reward points as per product feature if he/she does a transaction through HDFC Bank SmartBuy on IRCTC. All other existing SmartBuy offers will be applicable as per SmartBuy Terms & Conditions. What is the loyalty number printed on the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? The loyalty number printed on the back of your IRCTC HDFC Bank Card plastic is a an 11-digit number which gets allocated on approval of the card application. Cardholder shall avail the benefits of the IRCTC HDFC Bank Card by linking the IRCTC HDFC Bank Card loyalty number to his/her existing IRCTC login id. How to link your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card loyalty number with your IRCTC login? You can link your 11 digits loyalty number post joining fee payment of your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card. You need to use the same email id, mobile no. and date of birth that was mentioned while applying for the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card. Steps for linking the loyalty number with IRCTC login id are mentioned below: Visit IRCTC Ticketing Website/Rail Connect App and access the IRCTC account with your existing login id (Username and password). In case you do not have an existing login id on IRCTC Ticketing Website then you would need to register yourself by signing up at IRCTC. Select the option- “Add Loyalty Account “link provided under Loyalty Account Tab. Enter the 11 digits Loyalty Number printed at the back of your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card, then click on sent OTP. Enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number and click on Confirm. After entering the OTP, cardholder will receive confirmation message of successful linking of Loyalty Account. You can check your Loyalty Account details under the “Loyalty Account tab”. You will not be able to link your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card if there is a mismatch in the email id, mobile no. and date of birth that was mentioned while applying for the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card. You can call on IRCTC customer care on 14646 or 0755-6610661/0755-4090600 if you are unable to link your IRCTC HDFC Bank Card loyalty number with your IRCTC login ID and password. Can I withdraw cash through IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? Yes, you can withdraw cash via this Credit Card through any ATM. However, the Bank will charge a cash advance fee of 2.5% of the transaction amount or a minimum of RS. ₹500 whichever is higher. At HDFC Bank, we offer a cash advance limit of 40 %. So, if your Credit Card limit is Rs ₹1 lakh, you can withdraw cash up to Rs ₹40,000. The type of your Credit Card ascertains your cash advance limit. What should I do if my card is lost or damaged? If your Credit Card is lost or stolen, you should immediately inform the Bank by visiting the nearest branch or by calling on the customer care number. Alternatively, login to HDFC Bank Online at once and report your lost or stolen card in the service requests section in the menu. How can I check the status of my credit card application? You can check the status of your Credit Card application by visiting the official website of the Bank. On the homepage, under the cards section, you will find an option of to ‘Track your Application’. You will be asked for an Application Reference Number (ARN), post which the Bank will be able to tell you the status of your Credit Card application. Below is the link available for application tracking https://www.hdfcbank.com/personal/pay/cards/credit-cards/track-your-credit-card What are the Reward Points? "Reward Points” shall mean the points earned by the Rewards Program members, for undertaking such transactions and activities as specified under the Rewards Program, which may be redeemed towards purchase of railway tickets and/ or other services on the Platform and/ or through any other redemption options/ on other platforms mutually agreed upon by the Parties. What is the validity for reward points? Reward points are valid for 2 years When will the earned Reward Points be posted in the cardholder statement? The total Reward points earned in a cycle will reflect in the subsequent month statement of the cardholder How can I check my reward point balance? Steps to check your Reward Points balance through NetBanking You can check your reward point balance in your NetBanking account. You need to login to your HDFC Bank NetBanking account Then go to Cards and click on Request Select your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card number Now select “Rewards” and you will be able to see your rewards balance. Steps to check your Reward Points balance through SmartBuy Login to your HDFC Bank SmartBuy account. Click on the “Unlock Reward Summary” tab would appear on the top right corner of your screen. You would need to input your mobile number registered with HDFC Bank, Last four digit of your Credit Card and your date of birth. You would be able to see your reward point balance once the details provided by you is are verified. How do I redeem these Points? You can use your HDFC Bank Reward Points for train ticket booking via SmartBuy Steps to redeem Reward Points from HDFC Bank SmartBuy: To redeem the Reward points, the customer needs to visit HDFC Bank SmartBuy Platform. https://offers.smartbuy.hdfcbank.com/v1/foryou Inside HDFC Bank SmartBuy platform, the customer can select IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card under Privileges. Either a customer can login after entering landing to the IRCTC HDFC Bank Card or customer can login later once prompted while trying to book the train ticket. To book the train ticket enter source station, destination, date of journey and submit the information Check the class of travel, click on the preferred train and check the seat availability for the proposed date(s). Enter your IRCTC Authorised Partner user ID or create an IRCTC Authorised Partner account if you don’t have one already. Submit the traveller’s details. Pay with Points + Pay or Pay option from IRCTC Co Brand Card. At payment gateway, the customer can see option to pay with Points + Pay with Credit Card or Pay with Credit Card. On the next payment page, the customer can see the Reward Point Slider that they can use to add the number of reward points for redemption Redemption can be made only against a maximum of 70% of fare ticket amount on train ticket booking via HDFC Bank SmartBuy, inclusive of fares of all the passengers and service charges levied by IRCTC. Is there any Reward Redemption charge? Yes. On successful points redemption HDFC Bank Credit Card will be charged Rs.₹99 + GST on the Credit Card. But this could change subject to HDFC Bank’s terms and conditions. Please read our terms and conditions regularly for any changes, if applicable. Do I need minimum points to redeem? Yes, you would need a minimum of 100 points to redeem. Is there any limit to redeem points? Yes, you can redeem up to a maximum of 70% of booking value through Reward Points. Rest will have to be paid via Credit Card. What if I don’t have enough Points to redeem? You can choose to pay partially using the reward points and the balance payment through your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card. Please remember that you would need a minimum 100 points to redeem. But, if you do not have enough reward points to redeem you can continue to pay full amount through IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card. Is IRCTC Executive lounge access available on IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? Customer can enjoy 8 Complimentary IRCTC Executive Lounge access per year (2 per quarter) ₹ 2/- will be charged from the customer’s account to validate the card for complimentary lounge access. This amount will be non-refundable. What facilities do I get in the IRCTC Executive Lounge? The complimentary access to IRCTC Executive Lounge will include the below facilities: Two Hours of lounge stay A/C comfortable sitting arrangements Access to washrooms / changing room 1 Buffet meal- Breakfast, Lunch or Dinner as per the time of visit. Unlimited tea & coffee Free Wi-Fi Charging points Newspaper and Magazine Any additional service such as recliners or more shall be chargeable separate as per the operator price for that service. How does a cardholder calculate Reward points earned on monthly spends? Reward Points are calculated on the spends made within the calendar month cycle. Only settled transactions within the calendar month will be considered for Reward Points posting. For example: Cardholder statement is received on every 18th of the month. The Reward Points accrued for cardholder transactions from 1st of January till 31st of January will be calculated and posted on the 1st of February and the same can be seen when cardholder the receives the statement on 18th of February. How can I check my eligibility for this card? Individuals above the age of 21 years can apply for the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card. Based on the Bank’s internal Policy, the potential customer will be given the card. Are reward points transferable? No, the reward points are not transferable and cannot be combined with the points accrued on any other HDFC Bank card account. What happens if a cardholder exceeded exceeds the quarterly complimentary IRCTC Executive Lounge visits on IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card ? All the visits exceeding the complimentary quarterly quota will be allowed at the discretion of lounge and will also be chargeable by the IRCTC Executive Lounge. As a Cardholder I am not getting Reward Points on spends, why so? Reward Points shall not be eligible for the following spends/transactions on the card, Fuel Spends Wallet loads / Gift or Prepaid Card load/ Voucher purchase Cash Advances Payment of Outstanding Balances Payment of card fees and other charges Government related transactions Education Smart EMI / Dial an EMI transaction Rental transactions Interest amount of Merchant EMI If a cardholder breaches the monthly cycle capping of the product feature, then Reward Points shall not be rewarded for the spends made beyond the monthly capping. Is there any capping for Cashback earned on IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card Features? Please note that there is a calendar month capping on Reward Points accrued on the below mentioned features The accrual of the 5 HDFC Bank Reward points on IRCTC spends is capped maximum at 1,000 Reward Points per month and 12,000 Reward points Annually. The accrual of the additional 5% cashback on Train Ticket Booking via HDFC BANK SmartBuy is capped maximum at ₹1,000 per month and ₹12,000 Reward points Annually. As a cardholder, I have not received my reward points for tickets booked through IRCTC Ticketing Website/ Rail Connect App? If a cardholder breaches the monthly cycle capping of the product feature of 1,000 Reward Points, then Reward Points shall not be rewarded for the spends done beyond the monthly capping. If the cardholder has not met the monthly cycle capping then the customer should contact the HDFC Bank Credit Card Customer Care. View More Travel. Earn. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. The IRCTC Credit Card, specifically the HDFC Bank IRCTC Credit Card, is a specialised Credit Card designed in collaboration with the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC). This card offers a range of benefits, including reward points, CashBack, travel perks, IRCTC executive lounge access, and more making it an ideal choice for frequent train travellers. What are the documents required to apply for an IRCTC Credit Card? (Need more clarity on the documents required) Documents required for the HDFC Bank IRCTC Credit Card include: Identity Proof Passport Aadhaar Card Voter ID Driving licence PAN card Passport size photos Address Proof Utility bills (electricity, water, gas, or telephone) Rental agreement Passport Aadhaar card Voter ID Income Proof Salary slips (for salaried individuals) Income Tax Returns (ITR) Form 16 Bank statements What is the are the travel offer benefits offered by IRCTC on the IRCTC Credit Card? The IRCTC Credit Card offers several travel benefits: 5 Reward Points for every ₹100 spent on the IRCTC ticketing website and the Rail Connect app. Additional 5% cashback on train ticket bookings via HDFC Bank SmartBuy. 8 complimentary access passes to select IRCTC executive lounges every year. 1% transaction charges waiver on transactions done on the IRCTC ticketing website and Rail Connect app. Can I withdraw money from the IRCTC Credit Card? Yes, you can withdraw cash using your IRCTC Credit Card, However, the bank will charge a cash advance fee of 2.5% of the transaction amount or a minimum of ₹500 whichever is higher. The bank also offers a cash advance limit of 40%. The type of your Credit Card ascertains your cash advance limit. Can I use the IRCTC Credit Card for international transactions? While the IRCTC Credit Card is primarily designed for domestic use, it may be accepted for international transactions. However, it's crucial to check with the issuing bank to confirm the card's international validity. Keep in mind that international transactions may attract additional charges, including currency conversion fees. What is the use of IRCTC Credit Card? The IRCTC Credit Card offers various benefits like reward points, cashback, lounge access, and transaction charge waivers. It can be used for making purchases on the IRCTC website and the Rail Connect app, earning reward points on every transaction. Additionally, the card offers cashback on various other expenses, fuel surcharge waivers, and access to exclusive lounges. How to apply for the IRCTC Credit Card? To apply for the IRCTC Credit Card, follow these general steps: Visit the official website of the HDFC Bank. Navigate to the credit card section and find the IRCTC Credit Card. Fill out the online application form with the required personal and financial details and documents. Submit the application and await approval from the bank. Once approved, the bank will dispatch the credit card to your registered address. What are the key features of the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? 5 Reward Point per ₹100 spent on IRCTC Ticketing Website/ Rail Connect App 1 Reward Point per ₹100 spent on all other merchant (Spends on EMI interest amount and repayment, Fuel, Wallet load, gift vouchers, prepaid card loading, cash advances, payment of outstanding balances, payment of card fee and other charges, Government charges, Education, rental transactions etc. are excluded). Additional 5% CashBack on Train ticket booking via HDFC Bank SmartBuy. Value of 1 RP= ₹1 for Train ticket booking Gift Voucher Worth ₹500 on first transaction within 37 days of card issuance. Gift Voucher worth ₹500 on quarterly spends of ₹30,000. Reversal of 1% Transaction charges on transactions done on IRCTC Ticketing Website and Rail Connect 8 Complimentary access to select IRCTC Executive Lounges every year (Max 2 per quarter) What are the Fees and Charges applicable on IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? First Year Joining Fee – ₹500/- + Applicable Taxes Renewal Membership Fee – ₹500/- + Applicable Taxes Can my Joining fee or Card renewal fee be waived off? Renewal fee can be waived off if a customer spends ₹1,50,000 or more in an anniversary year, before your Credit Card renewal date. What are the other benefits on of the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? 1% Fuel Surcharge waiver on fuel transactions (Minimum transaction of ₹400, Maximum transaction of ₹5,000 & Maximum CashBack of ₹250 per statement cycle) (Fuel surcharge varies from 1% to 2.5% of fuel transaction base amount. The rate of surcharge may vary depending on the fuel station and their acquiring bank. GST is as applicable and is not reversible.) How can I apply for IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? You can apply for this Credit Card through both online and offline modes. To apply online, you can visit the official website of HDFC Bank - http://www.hdfcbank.com or you can visit the official website of IRCTC – https://irctc.co.in To apply offline, you may visit the nearest branch of the bank to fill out the application form. How can I get my Welcome gift voucher? Customer will be eligible for a gift voucher worth Rs.₹500 on performing 1 transaction of any amount within the first 37 days from card issuance date. Activation vouchers will be issued to customers within 90 working days after the end of card issuance month. Bank will share the voucher code to customer via SMS/Email. Customers need to claim the voucher by visiting the link given in the Eligibility Mailer, or by sending an SMS according to the short codes given in the eligibility SMS. E-Vouchers will be triggered immediately to the customers on receipt of the-voucher choice. Post verification of voucher code the redeemed amount will be credited to cardholders e-wallet balance Customer can also book the ticket by using wallet balance. How many reward points will be earned if a cardholder spends through HDFC Bank SmartBuy? A cardholder will be eligible for an additional 5% CashBack + 5% as HDFC Bank Reward points as per product feature if he/she does a transaction through HDFC Bank SmartBuy on IRCTC. All other existing SmartBuy offers will be applicable as per SmartBuy Terms & Conditions. What is the loyalty number printed on the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? The loyalty number printed on the back of your IRCTC HDFC Bank Card plastic is a an 11-digit number which gets allocated on approval of the card application. Cardholder shall avail the benefits of the IRCTC HDFC Bank Card by linking the IRCTC HDFC Bank Card loyalty number to his/her existing IRCTC login id. How to link your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card loyalty number with your IRCTC login? You can link your 11 digits loyalty number post joining fee payment of your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card. You need to use the same email id, mobile no. and date of birth that was mentioned while applying for the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card. Steps for linking the loyalty number with IRCTC login id are mentioned below: Visit IRCTC Ticketing Website/Rail Connect App and access the IRCTC account with your existing login id (Username and password). In case you do not have an existing login id on IRCTC Ticketing Website then you would need to register yourself by signing up at IRCTC. Select the option- “Add Loyalty Account “link provided under Loyalty Account Tab. Enter the 11 digits Loyalty Number printed at the back of your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card, then click on sent OTP. Enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number and click on Confirm. After entering the OTP, cardholder will receive confirmation message of successful linking of Loyalty Account. You can check your Loyalty Account details under the “Loyalty Account tab”. You will not be able to link your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card if there is a mismatch in the email id, mobile no. and date of birth that was mentioned while applying for the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card. You can call on IRCTC customer care on 14646 or 0755-6610661/0755-4090600 if you are unable to link your IRCTC HDFC Bank Card loyalty number with your IRCTC login ID and password. Can I withdraw cash through IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? Yes, you can withdraw cash via this Credit Card through any ATM. However, the Bank will charge a cash advance fee of 2.5% of the transaction amount or a minimum of RS. ₹500 whichever is higher. At HDFC Bank, we offer a cash advance limit of 40 %. So, if your Credit Card limit is Rs ₹1 lakh, you can withdraw cash up to Rs ₹40,000. The type of your Credit Card ascertains your cash advance limit. What should I do if my card is lost or damaged? If your Credit Card is lost or stolen, you should immediately inform the Bank by visiting the nearest branch or by calling on the customer care number. Alternatively, login to HDFC Bank Online at once and report your lost or stolen card in the service requests section in the menu. How can I check the status of my credit card application? You can check the status of your Credit Card application by visiting the official website of the Bank. On the homepage, under the cards section, you will find an option of to ‘Track your Application’. You will be asked for an Application Reference Number (ARN), post which the Bank will be able to tell you the status of your Credit Card application. Below is the link available for application tracking https://www.hdfcbank.com/personal/pay/cards/credit-cards/track-your-credit-card What are the Reward Points? "Reward Points” shall mean the points earned by the Rewards Program members, for undertaking such transactions and activities as specified under the Rewards Program, which may be redeemed towards purchase of railway tickets and/ or other services on the Platform and/ or through any other redemption options/ on other platforms mutually agreed upon by the Parties. What is the validity for reward points? Reward points are valid for 2 years When will the earned Reward Points be posted in the cardholder statement? The total Reward points earned in a cycle will reflect in the subsequent month statement of the cardholder How can I check my reward point balance? Steps to check your Reward Points balance through NetBanking You can check your reward point balance in your NetBanking account. You need to login to your HDFC Bank NetBanking account Then go to Cards and click on Request Select your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card number Now select “Rewards” and you will be able to see your rewards balance. Steps to check your Reward Points balance through SmartBuy Login to your HDFC Bank SmartBuy account. Click on the “Unlock Reward Summary” tab would appear on the top right corner of your screen. You would need to input your mobile number registered with HDFC Bank, Last four digit of your Credit Card and your date of birth. You would be able to see your reward point balance once the details provided by you is are verified. How do I redeem these Points? You can use your HDFC Bank Reward Points for train ticket booking via SmartBuy Steps to redeem Reward Points from HDFC Bank SmartBuy: To redeem the Reward points, the customer needs to visit HDFC Bank SmartBuy Platform. https://offers.smartbuy.hdfcbank.com/v1/foryou Inside HDFC Bank SmartBuy platform, the customer can select IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card under Privileges. Either a customer can login after entering landing to the IRCTC HDFC Bank Card or customer can login later once prompted while trying to book the train ticket. To book the train ticket enter source station, destination, date of journey and submit the information Check the class of travel, click on the preferred train and check the seat availability for the proposed date(s). Enter your IRCTC Authorised Partner user ID or create an IRCTC Authorised Partner account if you don’t have one already. Submit the traveller’s details. Pay with Points + Pay or Pay option from IRCTC Co Brand Card. At payment gateway, the customer can see option to pay with Points + Pay with Credit Card or Pay with Credit Card. On the next payment page, the customer can see the Reward Point Slider that they can use to add the number of reward points for redemption Redemption can be made only against a maximum of 70% of fare ticket amount on train ticket booking via HDFC Bank SmartBuy, inclusive of fares of all the passengers and service charges levied by IRCTC. Is there any Reward Redemption charge? Yes. On successful points redemption HDFC Bank Credit Card will be charged Rs.₹99 + GST on the Credit Card. But this could change subject to HDFC Bank’s terms and conditions. Please read our terms and conditions regularly for any changes, if applicable. Do I need minimum points to redeem? Yes, you would need a minimum of 100 points to redeem. Is there any limit to redeem points? Yes, you can redeem up to a maximum of 70% of booking value through Reward Points. Rest will have to be paid via Credit Card. What if I don’t have enough Points to redeem? You can choose to pay partially using the reward points and the balance payment through your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card. Please remember that you would need a minimum 100 points to redeem. But, if you do not have enough reward points to redeem you can continue to pay full amount through IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card. Is IRCTC Executive lounge access available on IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card? Customer can enjoy 8 Complimentary IRCTC Executive Lounge access per year (2 per quarter) ₹ 2/- will be charged from the customer’s account to validate the card for complimentary lounge access. This amount will be non-refundable. What facilities do I get in the IRCTC Executive Lounge? The complimentary access to IRCTC Executive Lounge will include the below facilities: Two Hours of lounge stay A/C comfortable sitting arrangements Access to washrooms / changing room 1 Buffet meal- Breakfast, Lunch or Dinner as per the time of visit. Unlimited tea & coffee Free Wi-Fi Charging points Newspaper and Magazine Any additional service such as recliners or more shall be chargeable separate as per the operator price for that service. How does a cardholder calculate Reward points earned on monthly spends? Reward Points are calculated on the spends made within the calendar month cycle. Only settled transactions within the calendar month will be considered for Reward Points posting. For example: Cardholder statement is received on every 18th of the month. The Reward Points accrued for cardholder transactions from 1st of January till 31st of January will be calculated and posted on the 1st of February and the same can be seen when cardholder the receives the statement on 18th of February. How can I check my eligibility for this card? Individuals above the age of 21 years can apply for the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card. Based on the Bank’s internal Policy, the potential customer will be given the card. Are reward points transferable? No, the reward points are not transferable and cannot be combined with the points accrued on any other HDFC Bank card account. What happens if a cardholder exceeded exceeds the quarterly complimentary IRCTC Executive Lounge visits on IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card ? All the visits exceeding the complimentary quarterly quota will be allowed at the discretion of lounge and will also be chargeable by the IRCTC Executive Lounge. As a Cardholder I am not getting Reward Points on spends, why so? Reward Points shall not be eligible for the following spends/transactions on the card, Fuel Spends Wallet loads / Gift or Prepaid Card load/ Voucher purchase Cash Advances Payment of Outstanding Balances Payment of card fees and other charges Government related transactions Education Smart EMI / Dial an EMI transaction Rental transactions Interest amount of Merchant EMI If a cardholder breaches the monthly cycle capping of the product feature, then Reward Points shall not be rewarded for the spends made beyond the monthly capping. Is there any capping for Cashback earned on IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card Features? Please note that there is a calendar month capping on Reward Points accrued on the below mentioned features The accrual of the 5 HDFC Bank Reward points on IRCTC spends is capped maximum at 1,000 Reward Points per month and 12,000 Reward points Annually. The accrual of the additional 5% cashback on Train Ticket Booking via HDFC BANK SmartBuy is capped maximum at ₹1,000 per month and ₹12,000 Reward points Annually. As a cardholder, I have not received my reward points for tickets booked through IRCTC Ticketing Website/ Rail Connect App? If a cardholder breaches the monthly cycle capping of the product feature of 1,000 Reward Points, then Reward Points shall not be rewarded for the spends done beyond the monthly capping. If the cardholder has not met the monthly cycle capping then the customer should contact the HDFC Bank Credit Card Customer Care. View More Travel. Earn. Designed to complement your unique lifestyle, our lifestyle Credit Cards can elevate your shopping experience with reward points, cashback offers, travel perks and more. Choose the right lifestyle Credit Card for yourself and enjoy great discounts at your favourite restaurants, shows, grocery stores, and more. Eligibility Criteria to Apply for Lifestyle Credit Cards The eligibility criteria can vary across Credit Cards. Here’s a general criterion: Age: Minimum 21 & maximum 65 Nationality: Indian Employment status: Either self-employed or salaried individuals For certain Credit Cards, such as HDFC Bank’s Millennia Credit Card – patrons can apply till the age of 40. You also need to fulfil the minimum income criteria to be eligible for the card. Each card has a different income criterion which you can check online on the bank’s website. Features and Benefits of Lifestyle Credit Cards Welcome benefits: Upon signing up for a new lifestyle Credit Card you will likely receive welcome benefits in the form of vouchers, exclusive club memberships, and more. Reward points: The more you spend using your lifestyle Credit Card, the more reward points you can earn. These reward points can be redeemed in different ways depending on the card and other factors. Discounts: With certain lifestyle Credit Cards, you get flat discounts at select merchants; you may be able to earn additional discounts based on the reward system of your card. Fuel surcharge waiver: Some of the best lifestyle Credit Cards offer fuel surcharge waiver on fuel purchases. Documents Required Since you can apply for most HDFC Bank Credit Cards online, you’ll need to submit scanned copies of your ID, address and income proof. General documents include Aadhaar, PAN, valid passport, driver’s license, voter ID, bank statements, salary slips, etc. Things to Keep in Mind When You Choose a Lifestyle Credit Card Each card variant will have a different rewards system, some may offer reward points while others may offer cashback. Late payment charges shall be applicable if you don’t pay the Credit Card bill on time. This can impact your credit score. Interest will be applicable in outstanding balances and cash withdrawals. Ensure you borrow what you can repay. Welcome benefits may be provided only after you pay the joining fee or spend a specific amount in a specific duration. Check the associated terms and conditions. Your requirements are the most important factor in choosing a perfect Credit Card. If the rewards and benefits of a lifestyle Credit Card align with your interests or potential future spends, it is worth considering. A lifestyle Credit Card is a type of Credit Card that offers exclusive rewards and offers on lifestyle-related spends. The card offers special rewards when you spend a certain specific amount using the card, quarterly or annually. You may also enjoy travel perks like flight vouchers and airport lounge access. How to apply for lifestyle Credit Card? Go to the issuing bank’s website (HDFC Bank, for example), choose your preferred lifestyle Credit Card and apply online or visit the nearest branch. Are lifestyle Credit Cards lifetime free? Note that banks typically charge a Credit Card annual fee. However, they may give you the benefit of renewal fee waiver based on the volume of transactions done in a financial year. Are lifestyle cards worth getting? If you often engage in expenses related to entertainment, clothes, nightlife, and more, you should consider getting a lifestyle Credit Card to make the most of your expenses. What is the difference between a lifestyle Credit Card and a Credit Card? A lifestyle Credit Card is simply a type of Credit Card. Its benefits and rewards are focused on expenses done at restaurants, movies, events, online shopping, etc. A standard Credit Card may come with basic features like interest-free period, basic rewards on spends. Designed to complement your unique lifestyle, our lifestyle Credit Cards can elevate your shopping experience with reward points, cashback offers, travel perks and more. Choose the right lifestyle Credit Card for yourself and enjoy great discounts at your favourite restaurants, shows, grocery stores, and more. Eligibility Criteria to Apply for Lifestyle Credit Cards The eligibility criteria can vary across Credit Cards. Here’s a general criterion: Age: Minimum 21 & maximum 65 Nationality: Indian Employment status: Either self-employed or salaried individuals For certain Credit Cards, such as HDFC Bank’s Millennia Credit Card – patrons can apply till the age of 40. You also need to fulfil the minimum income criteria to be eligible for the card. Each card has a different income criterion which you can check online on the bank’s website. Features and Benefits of Lifestyle Credit Cards Welcome benefits: Upon signing up for a new lifestyle Credit Card you will likely receive welcome benefits in the form of vouchers, exclusive club memberships, and more. Reward points: The more you spend using your lifestyle Credit Card, the more reward points you can earn. These reward points can be redeemed in different ways depending on the card and other factors. Discounts: With certain lifestyle Credit Cards, you get flat discounts at select merchants; you may be able to earn additional discounts based on the reward system of your card. Fuel surcharge waiver: Some of the best lifestyle Credit Cards offer fuel surcharge waiver on fuel purchases. Documents Required Since you can apply for most HDFC Bank Credit Cards online, you’ll need to submit scanned copies of your ID, address and income proof. General documents include Aadhaar, PAN, valid passport, driver’s license, voter ID, bank statements, salary slips, etc. Things to Keep in Mind When You Choose a Lifestyle Credit Card Each card variant will have a different rewards system, some may offer reward points while others may offer cashback. Late payment charges shall be applicable if you don’t pay the Credit Card bill on time. This can impact your credit score. Interest will be applicable in outstanding balances and cash withdrawals. Ensure you borrow what you can repay. Welcome benefits may be provided only after you pay the joining fee or spend a specific amount in a specific duration. Check the associated terms and conditions. Your requirements are the most important factor in choosing a perfect Credit Card. If the rewards and benefits of a lifestyle Credit Card align with your interests or potential future spends, it is worth considering. A lifestyle Credit Card is a type of Credit Card that offers exclusive rewards and offers on lifestyle-related spends. The card offers special rewards when you spend a certain specific amount using the card, quarterly or annually. You may also enjoy travel perks like flight vouchers and airport lounge access. How to apply for lifestyle Credit Card? Go to the issuing bank’s website (HDFC Bank, for example), choose your preferred lifestyle Credit Card and apply online or visit the nearest branch. Are lifestyle Credit Cards lifetime free? Note that banks typically charge a Credit Card annual fee. However, they may give you the benefit of renewal fee waiver based on the volume of transactions done in a financial year. Are lifestyle cards worth getting? If you often engage in expenses related to entertainment, clothes, nightlife, and more, you should consider getting a lifestyle Credit Card to make the most of your expenses. What is the difference between a lifestyle Credit Card and a Credit Card? A lifestyle Credit Card is simply a type of Credit Card. Its benefits and rewards are focused on expenses done at restaurants, movies, events, online shopping, etc. A standard Credit Card may come with basic features like interest-free period, basic rewards on spends. Designed to complement your unique lifestyle, our lifestyle Credit Cards can elevate your shopping experience with reward points, cashback offers, travel perks and more. Choose the right lifestyle Credit Card for yourself and enjoy great discounts at your favourite restaurants, shows, grocery stores, and more. Apply for Lifestyle Credit Cards Credit Card Annual Fee* Best feature Apply Online Diners Club Privilege Credit Card ₹2,500 + taxes Complimentary annual memberships of Times Prime and Swiggy One as welcome benefit Apply now Millennia Credit Card ₹1,000 + taxes Get 5% cashback on Flipkart, Sony LIV, Myntra, Zomato, etc. Apply now Regalia Gold Credit Card ₹2,500 + taxes Earn 5X reward points with spends at Myntra, Nykaa, Reliance Digital, and Marks & Spencer Apply now MoneyBack+ Credit Card ₹500 + taxes Earn 10X CashPoints on Flipkart, Reliance Smart SuperStore, etc. Apply now *Fees & charges are subject to change. Eligibility Criteria to Apply for Lifestyle Credit Cards The eligibility criteria can vary across Credit Cards. Here’s a general criterion: Age: Minimum 21 & maximum 65 Nationality: Indian Employment status: Either self-employed or salaried individuals For certain Credit Cards, such as HDFC Bank’s Millennia Credit Card – patrons can apply till the age of 40. You also need to fulfil the minimum income criteria to be eligible for the card. Each card has a different income criterion which you can check online on the bank’s website. Features and Benefits of Lifestyle Credit Cards Welcome benefits: Upon signing up for a new lifestyle Credit Card you will likely receive welcome benefits in the form of vouchers, exclusive club memberships, and more. Reward points: The more you spend using your lifestyle Credit Card, the more reward points you can earn. These reward points can be redeemed in different ways depending on the card and other factors. Discounts: With certain lifestyle Credit Cards, you get flat discounts at select merchants; you may be able to earn additional discounts based on the reward system of your card. Fuel surcharge waiver: Some of the best lifestyle Credit Cards offer fuel surcharge waiver on fuel purchases. Documents Required Since you can apply for most HDFC Bank Credit Cards online, you’ll need to submit scanned copies of your ID, address and income proof. General documents include Aadhaar, PAN, valid passport, driver’s license, voter ID, bank statements, salary slips, etc. Things to Keep in Mind When You Choose a Lifestyle Credit Card Each card variant will have a different rewards system, some may offer reward points while others may offer cashback. Late payment charges shall be applicable if you don’t pay the Credit Card bill on time. This can impact your credit score. Interest will be applicable in outstanding balances and cash withdrawals. Ensure you borrow what you can repay. Welcome benefits may be provided only after you pay the joining fee or spend a specific amount in a specific duration. Check the associated terms and conditions. Your requirements are the most important factor in choosing a perfect Credit Card. If the rewards and benefits of a lifestyle Credit Card align with your interests or potential future spends, it is worth considering. A lifestyle Credit Card is a type of Credit Card that offers exclusive rewards and offers on lifestyle-related spends. The card offers special rewards when you spend a certain specific amount using the card, quarterly or annually. You may also enjoy travel perks like flight vouchers and airport lounge access. How to apply for lifestyle Credit Card? Go to the issuing bank’s website (HDFC Bank, for example), choose your preferred lifestyle Credit Card and apply online or visit the nearest branch. Are lifestyle Credit Cards lifetime free? Note that banks typically charge a Credit Card annual fee. However, they may give you the benefit of renewal fee waiver based on the volume of transactions done in a financial year. Are lifestyle cards worth getting? If you often engage in expenses related to entertainment, clothes, nightlife, and more, you should consider getting a lifestyle Credit Card to make the most of your expenses. What is the difference between a lifestyle Credit Card and a Credit Card? A lifestyle Credit Card is simply a type of Credit Card. Its benefits and rewards are focused on expenses done at restaurants, movies, events, online shopping, etc. A standard Credit Card may come with basic features like interest-free period, basic rewards on spends. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. To apply for Marriott Bonvoy HDFC Bank Credit Card, his credit limit for the card he already holds in HDFC Bank should be minimum 1L/ month. The card will be issued with a credit limit of Rs 5000 temporarily up to 5-7 working days, the limit of your existing HDFC Bank Credit Card will be updated on this new card as shared limit. A detailed communication will also be sent to explain how the shared limit will function. How can a customer apply for Marriott Bonvoy HDFC Bank Credit Card, if he already has a credit card with HDFC Bank? Customer can apply through digital application form or can visit the nearest bank branch and apply by filling physical application form and floater declaration form. When will cardmember’s Marriott Bonvoy Membership Number be generated? Once the Marriott Bonvoy HDFC Bank Credit Card is approved, Membership Number will be generated within 10 working days. On successful Membership Number generation, cardmember will receive communication from Marriott on their registered Email ID within 72hours.
