evidence_data.value: Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. In case the credit card is not activated within 30 days of card open date, grace period of 7 days will be given to activate the card with the below mentioned modes. Upon calling the IVR please input your card number, validate through OTP and set your preferred PIN. Through NetBanking – Log in to our Net Banking and visit Cards. Reward Points Redemption & Validity Customers can redeem their reward points in two ways – As cashback in the statement against their outstanding credit card balance through HDFC Bank Netbanking portal. Towards a wide range of offerings on HDFC Bank SmartBuy platform. Redemption value 1 Reward Point is equivalent to Re.1 when redeemed as cashback against statement credit 1 Reward Point is equivalent to Re.0.3 of SmartBuy (Flights/Hotels, Airmiles & Product Catalogue). Please Note - The minimum Reward Point balance required for redemption against the statement balance is 500 Reward Points. Unredeemed Reward Points will expire/lapse after 2 years from the date of accumulation. Maximum cashback redemption of Rs 7,500 per calendar month. If the cardholder opts for redemption as Cashback against statement, there will be no redemption fee levied. Check Eligibility Know more about the card Credit Card Management & Controls How to Apply Fees & Charges Credit Card Activation Reward Points Redemption & Validity Additional Features Most Important Terms and Conditions Credit Card Management & Controls Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. IVR To enable or modify your HDFC Bank Credit Card controls and transaction limits, you can contact HDFC Bank's toll-free numbers: Toll-free numbers: 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available from 8 am to 8 pm) For overseas travel assistance: 022-61606160 By contacting our toll-free numbers, you can enable/modify limits for Domestic, International, Online, Contactless, ATM, and POS transactions on your Debit or Credit Card. How To Apply Steps to Apply: Login to the PhonePe APP. Look for PhonePe HDFC Credit card banner in the APP. Start application by filling in the details. Note: You can apply only through the PhonePe App. There is no offline or web-based application process. Eligibility Criteria – Nationality: Indian Age: 21 to 65 years Disclaimer - The final application decision, variant (Ultimo or Uno) & credit limit will be subject to Bank's internal policies. Fees & Charges Joining Fee: ₹999 + applicable taxes Annual Fee: ₹999 + applicable taxes Annual Year Fee waived upon spending ₹2,00,000 in the previous year. Below spends will not be considered for the waiver – Cash advances Credit Card fees or any charges All EMI spends Any other categories excluded as per the Bank’s internal policies Credit Card Activation Process HDFC Bank Credit Card holders have to activate their Credit Cards within 30 days from Card Open Date, as per ‘Master Direction – Credit and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022’ dated April 21, 2022 realized by Reserve bank of India (RBI). In case the credit card is not activated within 30 days of card open date, grace period of 7 days will be given to activate the card with the below mentioned modes. End of 37th day card will be closed (Details: rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_ViewMasDirections.aspx?id=12300) Modes for Card Activation: By setting Credit Card PIN: Through Credit Card usage - Use your Credit Card for at least 1 Online or POS transactions to keep your Credit Card active. Through MyCards - Login to mycards.hdfc.bank.in > Choose Add -Credit Card > Enter the last 4 digits of your new credit card > Select Set PIN > input your desired 4 digit PIN Through ATM – Card holders can set their 4-digit Credit Card PIN at HDFC BANK ATM with green PIN shared to the registered Mobile No. Through IVR – Card holders can set their 4-digit Credit Card PIN by calling IVR No. 1860 266 0333. Upon calling the IVR please input your card number, validate through OTP and set your preferred PIN. Through NetBanking – Log in to our Net Banking and visit Cards. Choose Change PIN and set your preferred PIN (available only for customers holding savings/salary/current accounts) Enabling your online, contactless and international transactions: Through Whatsapp Banking – Please save the number 7070022222 and send a message "Manage My Credit Card" to enable. Alternatively, you can click here. Through Eva – To interact with Eva, please click here and choose your preferred transactions to enable. Reward Points Redemption & Validity Customers can redeem their reward points in two ways – As cashback in the statement against their outstanding credit card balance through HDFC Bank Netbanking portal. Towards a wide range of offerings on HDFC Bank SmartBuy platform. Redemption value 1 Reward Point is equivalent to Re.1 when redeemed as cashback against statement credit 1 Reward Point is equivalent to Re.0.3 of SmartBuy (Flights/Hotels, Airmiles & Product Catalogue). Please Note - The minimum Reward Point balance required for redemption against the statement balance is 500 Reward Points. Unredeemed Reward Points will expire/lapse after 2 years from the date of accumulation. Maximum cashback redemption of Rs 7,500 per calendar month. If the cardholder opts for redemption as Cashback against statement, there will be no redemption fee levied. Additional Features Interest-free Credit Period - Get up to 50 days of interest-free credit from the date of purchase. (subject to submission of the charge by the merchant) Zero Cost Card Liability - Available on any fraudulent transactions made on your Credit Card if reported immediately to HDFC Bank’s 24-hour Call Centre. evidence_data.value: Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. IVR To enable or modify your HDFC Bank Credit Card controls and transaction limits, you can contact HDFC Bank's toll-free numbers: Toll-free numbers: 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available from 8 am to 8 pm) For overseas travel assistance: 022-61606160 By contacting our toll-free numbers, you can enable/modify limits for Domestic, International, Online, Contactless, ATM, and POS transactions on your Debit or Credit Card.

evidence_data.value: HDFC Bank Credit Card holders have to activate their Credit Cards within 30 days from Card Open Date, as per ‘Master Direction – Credit and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022’ dated April 21, 2022 realized by Reserve bank of India (RBI). In case the credit card is not activated within 30 days of card open date, grace period of 7 days will be given to activate the card with the below mentioned modes. End of 37th day card will be closed (Details: rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_ViewMasDirections.aspx?id=12300) Modes for Card Activation: By setting Credit Card PIN: Through Credit Card usage - Use your Credit Card for at least 1 Online or POS transactions to keep your Credit Card active. Through MyCards - Login to mycards.hdfc.bank.in > Choose Add -Credit Card > Enter the last 4 digits of your new credit card > Select Set PIN > input your desired 4 digit PIN Through ATM – Card holders can set their 4-digit Credit Card PIN at HDFC BANK ATM with green PIN shared to the registered Mobile No. Through IVR – Card holders can set their 4-digit Credit Card PIN by calling IVR No. 1860 266 0333. Upon calling the IVR please input your card number, validate through OTP and set your preferred PIN. Through NetBanking – Log in to our Net Banking and visit Cards. Choose Change PIN and set your preferred PIN (available only for customers holding savings/salary/current accounts) Enabling your online, contactless and international transactions: Through Whatsapp Banking – Please save the number 7070022222 and send a message "Manage My Credit Card" to enable. Alternatively, you can click here. Through Eva – To interact with Eva, please click here and choose your preferred transactions to enable.

evidence_data.value: Customers can redeem their reward points in two ways – As cashback in the statement against their outstanding credit card balance through HDFC Bank Netbanking portal. Towards a wide range of offerings on HDFC Bank SmartBuy platform. Redemption value 1 Reward Point is equivalent to Re.1 when redeemed as cashback against statement credit 1 Reward Point is equivalent to Re.0.3 of SmartBuy (Flights/Hotels, Airmiles & Product Catalogue). Please Note - The minimum Reward Point balance required for redemption against the statement balance is 500 Reward Points. Unredeemed Reward Points will expire/lapse after 2 years from the date of accumulation. Maximum cashback redemption of Rs 7,500 per calendar month. If the cardholder opts for redemption as Cashback against statement, there will be no redemption fee levied.

Check Eligibility Know more about the card Credit Card Management & Controls How to Apply Fees & Charges Credit Card Activation Reward Points Redemption & Validity Additional Features Most Important Terms and Conditions Credit Card Management & Controls Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. evidence_data.value: Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. IVR To enable or modify your HDFC Bank Credit Card controls and transaction limits, you can contact HDFC Bank's toll-free numbers: Toll-free numbers: 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available from 8 am to 8 pm) For overseas travel assistance: 022-61606160 By contacting our toll-free numbers, you can enable/modify limits for Domestic, International, Online, Contactless, ATM, and POS transactions on your Debit or Credit Card.

Now apply for the PIXEL Credit Card backed by an FD (No credit score or income proof needed!) Why choose an FD-backed Credit Card? Get up to 90% of your FD value as Credit Limit Earn interest on your FD and cashback on PIXEL Credit Card spends No income proof required How to apply? You can apply for the FD-backed PIXEL Credit Card exclusively via the HDFC Bank PayZapp mobile app. To know more about FD Backed PIXEL Credit Cards, Click here Don’t just spend, play your way to rewards with PIXEL Play Go cashless. Go limitless. With PIXEL Go Apply Now Documents required to get you started Identity Proof Passport Aadhaar card Voter ID Driving licence PAN card Passport size photograph Address Proof Utility bills (electricity, water, gas, or telephone) Rental agreement Passport Aadhaar card Voter ID Application Process You can easily apply for the PIXEL GO Credit Card by following the steps below:​ Step 1: Download or update the PayZapp app from the Google Play Store for Android or the App Store for iOS Step 2: Click on the 'Apply Now for PIXEL CREDIT CARD' banner on the PayZapp homepage. In certain cases, uploading documents and completing video KYC might be required*. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab > Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. Pay in Parts Enjoy hassle-free, one-click instant conversion of the PIXEL Go credit card outstanding balance* to EMIs from your PayZapp. EMI Dashboard: Manage all your live EMIs within the EMI dashboard from PayZapp. Flexibility: Choose low-cost and flexible tenures that suit best for your choice of repayment. You can choose between select transactions or outstanding balances*. 100% Digital: No documentation, email, or calling required. Simply convert to EMI and manage EMI repayments fully from your Payzapp. To know more detailed Terms & conditions click here Additional Features Zero lost card liability: In the unfortunate event of losing your HDFC Bank PIXEL Go Credit Card, on reporting it immediately to our 24-hour call centre, you have zero liability on any fraudulent transactions made on your Credit Card. Interest Free Credit Period: Up to 50 days of interest free period on your HDFC Bank PIXEL Go Credit Card from the date of purchase (subject to the submission of the charge by the Merchant) Revolving Credit: Available at a nominal interest rate on your HDFC Bank PIXEL Go Credit Card. Please refer to the Fees and Charges section to know more. Exclusive Dining Privileges: Enjoy 10% savings off on all your restaurant bill payments via Swiggy Dineout. To know more, click here PIXEL CashPoints CashBack will be credited in the form of PIXEL CashPoints and can be easily managed under the rewards section of the PIXEL Homepage in Payzapp. Upon the accumulation of 500 PIXEL CashPoints, they can be redeemed easily to the PayZapp Wallet and used to purchase your choice of brand vouchers within PayZapp digitally. PIXEL CashPoints are valid for 2 years from the date of accumulation. Statement & Repayments You can easily view and download the digital statements in the PayZapp and MyCards. ​ View the current outstanding on the card and make card repayment within the PIXEL Home page using payment methods like UPI & Debit Card. Repayment can also be made via third party(BBPS) apps on any BBPS-enabled banking,UPI or digital wallet app. Card Activation Download HDFC Bank PayZapp from Google Play or Apple App Store. Sign up using your mobile number (ensure it matches the one used for your PIXEL Card application). Access PIXEL Go: Look for the in-app nudge or notification on the PayZapp Home Page to access PIXEL Go. Set it up by selecting your billing cycle date. Activate & Go – Verify your email ID and click "Activate & Proceed". Done! Your PIXEL Go Credit Card is instantly activated and ready for use. (Note: Customers applying for PIXEL Credit Card via PayZapp will be issued with both RuPay & Visa network cards with RuPay as a Digital Card and Visa as a physical plastic card to your registered postal address as a standard issuance process. Please note a single consolidated PIXEL statement will be generated for both the cards together every month.) Set-up UPI PIN Set Up Your UPI PIN in a few steps: Open PayZapp and tap on "View PIXEL Home" on the home screen Navigate to Settings > "Set RuPay UPI" Verify your OTP, set your card PIN, and you're all set! Contactless Payments Swipe to Pay: HDFC Bank PIXEL Go Credit Card lets you make E- commerce transactions effortlessly with - Swipe to Pay. Now make quick and secure online payments without need of one-time password (OTP) sent via SMS. Tap & Pay: HDFC Bank PIXEL Go Credit Card has enabled contactless payments to facilitate fast, convenient and secure payments at retail outlets. Just tap once with either your phone or physical card and make hassle free offline payments. Scan and Pay: Through the PIXEL RuPay credit card, customers will be able to make payment to a merchant by scanning the QR code for unified Payment Interface (UPI) Payments. Scan & Pay Link Your HDFC Bank PIXEL RuPay Credit Card for Scan & Pay: Open PayZapp and tap the menu bar on the top left corner. Go to "UPI Accounts" under Account Management. Under Credit Cards, tap "Add New" and select HDFC Bank Credit Card. Enter the last 6 digits of your card and its expiry date, then proceed. Verify with OTP, enter your credit card PIN, and create your UPI PIN. Done! Your card is now linked for Scan & Pay transactions. Servicing via Help Center: You can easily refer to the FAQs for every section by clicking on “?” in the app screen to view and get answers to your questions. You can also raise a query ticket within the app if you need more help by clicking “Raise a Ticket”, and the service team will respond to your query in the app. How to Raise a Ticket? Tap "?" on the PIXEL Play Credit Card Home Page. Choose the relevant category and query. If your query isn’t listed, select "My query is not listed" to raise a ticket. Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. You can apply for the card directly by clicking here. You can also apply through PayZapp and receive instant approval. What CashBack benefits does the PIXEL Play Credit Card offer? PIXEL Play Credit Card offers 5% Cashback on selected brand, and 3% Cashback on choice of Ecommerce Platform. Customers are also eligible for 1% CashBack on all transactions, 5% on SmartBuy purchases, and 1% on UPI spends (for the RuPay variant). Can I convert purchases into EMIs? Yes, you can instantly convert transactions into EMIs via PayZapp, choosing from flexible tenure options. Which modes of contactless payments are available for PIXEL Play customers ? Customers can Tap & Pay at POS (Point of Sale), Swipe to Pay for online and UPI transactions, or Scan & Pay via UPI (for the RuPay variant). PIXEL Visa cardholders can also use Mobile Tap & Pay on NFC-enabled Android smartphones.​ How is interest calculated on unpaid balances? Interest on unpaid balances for the HDFC Bank Pixel Credit Card is calculated based on the Annual Percentage Rate (APR). If the full amount is not paid by the due date, interest is charged on the outstanding balance from the transaction date until the payment is made. What are the reissue charges for HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card? The reissue fee for the HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card are as 199 + gst. This fee applies when a card is reissued due to loss, theft, or damage. The charge is billed to the cardholder in the next statement. What is the fee for IRCTC transactions for HDFC Bank Pixel Play Cards? The fee for IRCTC transactions using the HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card is 1% of the transaction amount plus GST. This fee applies to all railway ticket purchases made through IRCTC, except for the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card. What is a cash advance fee for HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card? The cash advance fee for the HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card is 2.5% of the amount withdrawn or ₹500, whichever is higher. This fee is billed to the cardholder in the next statement. Additionally, finance charges apply from the withdrawal date until full payment is made. What is the interest-free grace period for the HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card? The HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card offers a grace period of 20 to 50 days from the date of purchase. This period is subject to the merchant submitting the charge and is not applicable if the previous month's balance has not been cleared in full. What are the foreign transaction charges? The HDFC Bank Pixel Credit Card charges a 3.5% foreign transaction fee on all international purchases. This fee covers the cost of currency conversion and processing international transactions. Is there a fuel surcharge on HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card? The HDFC Bank Pixel Credit Card offers a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions between ₹400 and ₹5,000 at all fuel stations across India. The maximum waiver is ₹250 per statement cycle. You can apply for the card directly by clicking here. You can also apply through PayZapp and receive instant approval. What CashBack benefits does the PIXEL Play Credit Card offer? PIXEL Play Credit Card offers 5% Cashback on selected brand, and 3% Cashback on choice of Ecommerce Platform. Customers are also eligible for 1% CashBack on all transactions, 5% on SmartBuy purchases, and 1% on UPI spends (for the RuPay variant). Can I convert purchases into EMIs? Yes, you can instantly convert transactions into EMIs via PayZapp, choosing from flexible tenure options. Which modes of contactless payments are available for PIXEL Play customers ? Customers can Tap & Pay at POS (Point of Sale), Swipe to Pay for online and UPI transactions, or Scan & Pay via UPI (for the RuPay variant). PIXEL Visa cardholders can also use Mobile Tap & Pay on NFC-enabled Android smartphones.​ How is interest calculated on unpaid balances? Interest on unpaid balances for the HDFC Bank Pixel Credit Card is calculated based on the Annual Percentage Rate (APR). If the full amount is not paid by the due date, interest is charged on the outstanding balance from the transaction date until the payment is made. What are the reissue charges for HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card? The reissue fee for the HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card are as 199 + gst. This fee applies when a card is reissued due to loss, theft, or damage. The charge is billed to the cardholder in the next statement. What is the fee for IRCTC transactions for HDFC Bank Pixel Play Cards? The fee for IRCTC transactions using the HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card is 1% of the transaction amount plus GST. This fee applies to all railway ticket purchases made through IRCTC, except for the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card. What is a cash advance fee for HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card? The cash advance fee for the HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card is 2.5% of the amount withdrawn or ₹500, whichever is higher. This fee is billed to the cardholder in the next statement. Additionally, finance charges apply from the withdrawal date until full payment is made. What is the interest-free grace period for the HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card? The HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card offers a grace period of 20 to 50 days from the date of purchase. This period is subject to the merchant submitting the charge and is not applicable if the previous month's balance has not been cleared in full. What are the foreign transaction charges? The HDFC Bank Pixel Credit Card charges a 3.5% foreign transaction fee on all international purchases. This fee covers the cost of currency conversion and processing international transactions. Is there a fuel surcharge on HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card? The HDFC Bank Pixel Credit Card offers a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions between ₹400 and ₹5,000 at all fuel stations across India. The maximum waiver is ₹250 per statement cycle. Please note a single consolidated PIXEL statement will be generated for both the cards together every month.

Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. IVR To enable or modify your HDFC Bank Credit Card controls and transaction limits, you can contact HDFC Bank's toll-free numbers: Toll-free numbers: 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available from 8 am to 8 pm) For overseas travel assistance: 022-61606160 By contacting our toll-free numbers, you can enable/modify limits for Domestic, International, Online, Contactless, ATM, and POS transactions on your Debit or Credit Card.

Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. IVR To enable or modify your HDFC Bank Credit Card controls and transaction limits, you can contact HDFC Bank's toll-free numbers: Toll-free numbers: 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available from 8 am to 8 pm) For overseas travel assistance: 022-61606160 By contacting our toll-free numbers, you can enable/modify limits for Domestic, International, Online, Contactless, ATM, and POS transactions on your Debit or Credit Card.

evidence_data.value: Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled.
