Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Eligibility Criteria The following are the eligibility criteria to apply for a Rewards Credit Card: You must be a minimum of 21 years old. You should be an Indian national. You should be either a salaried professional or a self-employed individual. HDFC Bank assesses your eligibility and determines your credit limit for a Credit Card based on your annual income. Documents Required to Apply for Rewards Credit Cards The following documents are generally required to apply for a Rewards Credit Card: For Identity and Address Proof You can use your Aadhaar Card, Indian passport, Voter ID card, or driving licence. Read More Frequently Asked Questions What are Rewards Credit Cards? Rewards Credit Cards offer benefits or incentives for cardholders in the form of CashBack, points, miles, or specific benefits. These rewards are earned based on the cardholder's spending and can be redeemed for various benefits, such as discounts, travel, merchandise, or gift vouchers. How do I apply for a Rewards Credit Card? To apply for an HDFC Bank Rewards Credit Card, here is what you need to do: Visit the HDFC Bank website, choose the specific rewards card you are interested in. Complete the online application form with your personal and financial information. Our team will review your application and issue the card upon successful verification. Are Rewards Credit Cards lifetime free? The fee structure varies by card, so it is essential to check the terms and conditions of the specific rewards Credit Card you are interested in to understand its fee policy. Are Rewards Credit Cards good? Rewards Credit Cards offer substantial benefits, such as CashBack, points, or miles, which can add up over time. You can use these Credit Cards to pay for daily expenses and take advantage of rewards to save more. What is the difference between a Rewards Credit Card and a Credit Card? Reward Credit Card offer incentives and benefits tied to spending that can help you save more money, while a standard Credit Card does not offer such rewards. Which Credit Card offers more rewards? ​​​The number of rewards offered by a Credit Card varies widely based on the specific card and its rewards program. Eligibility Criteria The following are the eligibility criteria to apply for a Rewards Credit Card: You must be a minimum of 21 years old. You should be an Indian national. You should be either a salaried professional or a self-employed individual. HDFC Bank assesses your eligibility and determines your credit limit for a Credit Card based on your annual income. Documents Required to Apply for Rewards Credit Cards The following documents are generally required to apply for a Rewards Credit Card: For Identity and Address Proof You can use your Aadhaar Card, Indian passport, Voter ID card, or driving licence. Read More For Income Proof Please provide your Permanent Account Number (PAN), salary slips, or income tax returns for the previous three years. Read More Sign-up Bonuses Reward Credit Cards provide a welcome bonus to significantly boost your points or CashBack when you first utilise the card. Read More Frequently Asked Questions What are Rewards Credit Cards? Rewards Credit Cards offer benefits or incentives for cardholders in the form of CashBack, points, miles, or specific benefits. These rewards are earned based on the cardholder's spending and can be redeemed for various benefits, such as discounts, travel, merchandise, or gift vouchers. How do I apply for a Rewards Credit Card? To apply for an HDFC Bank Rewards Credit Card, here is what you need to do: Visit the HDFC Bank website, choose the specific rewards card you are interested in. Complete the online application form with your personal and financial information. Our team will review your application and issue the card upon successful verification. Are Rewards Credit Cards lifetime free? The fee structure varies by card, so it is essential to check the terms and conditions of the specific rewards Credit Card you are interested in to understand its fee policy. Are Rewards Credit Cards good? Rewards Credit Cards offer substantial benefits, such as CashBack, points, or miles, which can add up over time. You can use these Credit Cards to pay for daily expenses and take advantage of rewards to save more. What is the difference between a Rewards Credit Card and a Credit Card? Reward Credit Card offer incentives and benefits tied to spending that can help you save more money, while a standard Credit Card does not offer such rewards. Which Credit Card offers more rewards? ​​​The number of rewards offered by a Credit Card varies widely based on the specific card and its rewards program. You can compare the Rewards Credit Card of HDFC Bank to find out the most rewarding Credit Card that aligns best with your financial goals and lifestyle. Eligibility Criteria The following are the eligibility criteria to apply for a Rewards Credit Card: You must be a minimum of 21 years old. You should be an Indian national. You should be either a salaried professional or a self-employed individual. HDFC Bank assesses your eligibility and determines your credit limit for a Credit Card based on your annual income. Documents Required to Apply for Rewards Credit Cards The following documents are generally required to apply for a Rewards Credit Card: For Identity and Address Proof You can use your Aadhaar Card, Indian passport, Voter ID card, or driving licence. Read More For Income Proof Please provide your Permanent Account Number (PAN), salary slips, or income tax returns for the previous three years. Read More Features and Benefits of Rewards Credit Cards Earn While You Spend Rewards Credit Cards allow you to accumulate points or cashback as you make everyday purchases that you can redeem, helping you to save more on every purchase. Read More Flexible Redemption Options HDFC Bank Reward Credit Cards offer a variety of ways to redeem your earned Reward Points, from travel vouchers and merchandise to CashBack and gift cards, giving you flexibility in how you use your rewards. Read More Sign-up Bonuses Reward Credit Cards provide a welcome bonus to significantly boost your points or CashBack when you first utilise the card. Read More Additional Perks Depending on the card, you can also benefit from benefits like roadside assistance, airport assistance, concierge services and entertainment discounts that enhances your overall experience. Read More Things To Keep In Mind When Choosing A Rewards Credit Card Here are some things to consider when choosing a Rewards Credit Card: Rewards Structure Different rewards Credit Cards offer diverse types of rewards, such as CashBack, points, miles, or specific benefits like discounts on travel or dining. Assess which type of rewards aligns best with your interests and lifestyle. Analyse different options against your requirements before finalising a card. Read More Annual Fee HDFC Bank Rewards Credit Cards come with an annual fee and other charges such as cash withdrawal charges, late payment charges and GST (Goods and Services Tax charges. Read More Rewards Redemption Check ways how you can easily redeem your earned rewards. HDFC Bank allows you to redeem points through NetBanking, turn them into Insta vouchers, redeem against product catalogue on SmartBuy and convert them into air miles. Read More Frequently Asked Questions What are Rewards Credit Cards? Rewards Credit Cards offer benefits or incentives for cardholders in the form of CashBack, points, miles, or specific benefits. These rewards are earned based on the cardholder's spending and can be redeemed for various benefits, such as discounts, travel, merchandise, or gift vouchers. How do I apply for a Rewards Credit Card? To apply for an HDFC Bank Rewards Credit Card, here is what you need to do: Visit the HDFC Bank website, choose the specific rewards card you are interested in. Complete the online application form with your personal and financial information. Our team will review your application and issue the card upon successful verification. Are Rewards Credit Cards lifetime free? The fee structure varies by card, so it is essential to check the terms and conditions of the specific rewards Credit Card you are interested in to understand its fee policy. Are Rewards Credit Cards good? Rewards Credit Cards offer substantial benefits, such as CashBack, points, or miles, which can add up over time. You can use these Credit Cards to pay for daily expenses and take advantage of rewards to save more. What is the difference between a Rewards Credit Card and a Credit Card? Reward Credit Card offer incentives and benefits tied to spending that can help you save more money, while a standard Credit Card does not offer such rewards. Which Credit Card offers more rewards? ​​​The number of rewards offered by a Credit Card varies widely based on the specific card and its rewards program. You can compare the Rewards Credit Card of HDFC Bank to find out the most rewarding Credit Card that aligns best with your financial goals and lifestyle. The Regalia Gold Credit Card is offered by HDFC Bank to customers that aim to spend money on online and offline purchases that they make. Is the Regalia Gold Credit Card free? No, a joining or membership fee of ₹2,500 + taxes needs to be paid when you apply for the Regalia Gold. However, against these fees paid, you receive a welcome benefit of ₹2,500 in terms of a gift voucher. You can also get a renewal fee waiver by spending ₹4 lakh annually. To avail yourself of all these benefits and maximise savings, you can consider upgrading to a Regalia Gold Credit Card. How to apply for the Regalia Gold Credit Card? The Regalia Gold Credit Card is offered by HDFC Bank to customers that aim to spend money on online and offline purchases that they make. The Regalia Gold offers a wide range of features and benefits, including premium membership, airport lounge access, reward points on retail transactions, and more. Is the Regalia Gold Credit Card free? No, a joining or membership fee of ₹2,500 + taxes needs to be paid when you apply for the Regalia Gold. However, against these fees paid, you receive a welcome benefit of ₹2,500 in terms of a gift voucher. You can also get a renewal fee waiver by spending ₹4 lakh annually. Why should you upgrade to a Regalia Gold Credit Card? Regalia Gold Credit Cards offers you a wide range of benefits such as a renewal fee waiver, complimentary membership of Swiggy One and MMT Black Gold, Spend Milestone based vouchers worth Rs 1500 quarterly, up to Rs 10000 annually and The Boarding Edge Program. You also earn Rewards Points on your every spend and redeem them for exciting rewards. To avail yourself of all these benefits and maximise savings, you can consider upgrading to a Regalia Gold Credit Card. How to apply for the Regalia Gold Credit Card? You can apply for the Regalia Gold Credit Card online on our website. Submit the required documents, online or by visiting your nearest branch. Upon approval, you get your new Regalia Gold Credit Card What are the documents required to obtain a Regalia Gold Credit Card? Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. evidence_data.value: Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Credit Card Management & Controls Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Benefits of RuPay Credit Cards Reward Points With HDFC Bank RuPay Credit Cards, you can earn reward points on various types of expenses, including groceries, dining, and bill payments. Interest-Free Period HDFC Bank provides a 50-day interest-free period on your RuPay Credit Card purchases, allowing you to make payments within a specific timeframe without incurring interest charges. RuPay Credit Card Link with UPI RuPay Cards are enabled for UPI payments. You can easily link your RuPay Credit Card with various payment apps and use it to transact though UPI. To register for UPI, you need to set up your Credit Card PIN. Just dial 1860 266 0333. Here is how you can link RuPay Card with UPI: Download and open your preferred UPI-enabled app, such as PayZapp. Register your HDFC Bank UPI RuPay Credit Card within the app. Once registered, you can start making UPI payments using your Credit Card. How to link HDFC Bank RuPay Credit Card on PayZapp app? Existing PayZapp Users Follow these simple steps to link your RuPay Card with UPI: Choose 'RuPay Credit Card' and then select your Credit Card issuer to seamlessly link your RuPay Credit Card. Select 'UPI Accounts' and click on the '+ Add new' option. Log in to your PayZapp account and navigate to the 'Accounts & Cards' section. New PayZapp Users Follow the provided steps to get started with PayZapp and start using your RuPay Card for UPI payments. Download the PayZapp app from either the Google Play Store or the Apple App Store. Complete the PayZapp registration process. Head to ‘Accounts & Cards’ section and select '+ Add New’ option. Select ‘RuPay Credit Card' to set up your UPI. Choose the 'HDFC Bank Credit Card' to conveniently fetch and link your HDFC Bank RuPay Credit card. Set up your UPI PIN, by following these steps: Navigate to the PayZapp Home screen. Select 'Accounts & Cards,' then 'UPI Accounts.' Click on the 'Credit Cards' tab. Enter the last 6 digits of your card and its expiry date. Enter the One-Time Password (OTP). Enter your Credit Card PIN. Follow the prompts to set your UPI PIN. Making UPI payments with HDFC Bank RuPay Credit Card Launch your preferred UPI payment app such as PayZapp. Scan the UPI QR (Quick Response) code of the merchant or enter their details. Input the desired amount and choose your linked RuPay Credit Card. For enhanced convenience, opt for your HDFC Bank RuPay Credit Card account. Enter your UPI PIN to complete the payment. Get the payment confirmation receipt. UPI Transactions via RuPay Credit Card Only person to merchant (P2M) transactions are allowed when you use your RuPay Credit Card for UPI transactions: Online & Offline Shopping: You can make payments at online and offline retail stores, supermarkets, shopping malls, e-commerce websites. Utilities: Pay for services like electricity, gas, water, internet, etc., via UPI, using your RuPay Credit Card. Food Deliveries & Dining Out: You can pay food establishments or food delivery platforms for their services via UPI. Subscription Services: You can pay for multiple subscription services via UPI linked to your RuPay Credit Cards. Plus, you can also set up automatic payments for recurring transactions. Travel Bookings: Whether train, flight, bus, travel packages or more, you can make your travel-related bookings via UPI. QR Code Payments: You can scan merchant QR codes and pay using UPI linked to your RuPay Credit Card. The transaction amount will be deducted from your RuPay Credit Card’s credit limit and billed to you in the subsequent Credit Card statement. Note: Peer-to-peer (P2P), peer-to-peer merchant (P2M), cash withdrawal at ATMs or merchants, Mutual Funds payments, foreign inward remittances, payments on lending platforms, initial public offering (IPO) subscription and other such payments are not permitted on the UPI linked to the RuPay Credit Card. Benefits of UPI transaction through RuPay Credit Card Easy Bill Payments You can conveniently use your RuPay Credit Card for UPI transactions to pay bills, including utility bills, mobile recharge, and more. Earn Rewards By using your RuPay Credit Card for UPI payments, you can enjoy the convenience of UPI payments and earn rewards, such as cashback, reward points, or discounts. Credit Card Benefits UPI transactions made through your RuPay Credit Card enable you to enjoy card benefits, such as interest-free credit periods, lounge access and insurance coverage, depending on your card type. How Does a RuPay Card Work? A RuPay Credit Card operates seamlessly with a Chip+PIN technology. With the Credit Cards, you can pay for goods and services based on your promise to pay the bank for the utilised amount along with other charges. You can use the card for online purchases, shopping at POS, purchases on EMI and cash withdrawal from ATMs. Where are RuPay Credit Cards Accepted? RuPay Credit Cards are widely accepted in India for Point of Sale (PoS) transactions, ATM withdrawals, and e-commerce purchases. They can also be used for international transaction at PoS terminals, ATMs, and e-commerce websites that are enabled for Discover Financial Service (DFS). Clear All Compare Link to UPI & earn! Credit Card Management & Controls Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. RuPay Credit Card Link with UPI RuPay Cards are enabled for UPI payments. You can easily link your RuPay Credit Card with various payment apps and use it to transact though UPI. To register for UPI, you need to set up your Credit Card PIN. Just dial 1860 266 0333. Here is how you can link RuPay Card with UPI: Download and open your preferred UPI-enabled app, such as PayZapp. Register your HDFC Bank UPI RuPay Credit Card within the app. Once registered, you can start making UPI payments using your Credit Card. How to link HDFC Bank RuPay Credit Card on PayZapp app? Existing PayZapp Users Follow these simple steps to link your RuPay Card with UPI: Choose 'RuPay Credit Card' and then select your Credit Card issuer to seamlessly link your RuPay Credit Card. Select 'UPI Accounts' and click on the '+ Add new' option. Log in to your PayZapp account and navigate to the 'Accounts & Cards' section. New PayZapp Users Follow the provided steps to get started with PayZapp and start using your RuPay Card for UPI payments. Download the PayZapp app from either the Google Play Store or the Apple App Store. Complete the PayZapp registration process. Head to ‘Accounts & Cards’ section and select '+ Add New’ option. Select ‘RuPay Credit Card' to set up your UPI. Choose the 'HDFC Bank Credit Card' to conveniently fetch and link your HDFC Bank RuPay Credit card. Set up your UPI PIN, by following these steps: Navigate to the PayZapp Home screen. Select 'Accounts & Cards,' then 'UPI Accounts.' Click on the 'Credit Cards' tab. Enter the last 6 digits of your card and its expiry date. Enter the One-Time Password (OTP). Enter your Credit Card PIN. Follow the prompts to set your UPI PIN. Making UPI payments with HDFC Bank RuPay Credit Card Launch your preferred UPI payment app such as PayZapp. Scan the UPI QR (Quick Response) code of the merchant or enter their details. Input the desired amount and choose your linked RuPay Credit Card. For enhanced convenience, opt for your HDFC Bank RuPay Credit Card account. Enter your UPI PIN to complete the payment. Get the payment confirmation receipt. UPI Transactions via RuPay Credit Card Only person to merchant (P2M) transactions are allowed when you use your RuPay Credit Card for UPI transactions: Online & Offline Shopping: You can make payments at online and offline retail stores, supermarkets, shopping malls, e-commerce websites. Utilities: Pay for services like electricity, gas, water, internet, etc., via UPI, using your RuPay Credit Card. Food Deliveries & Dining Out: You can pay food establishments or food delivery platforms for their services via UPI. Subscription Services: You can pay for multiple subscription services via UPI linked to your RuPay Credit Cards. Plus, you can also set up automatic payments for recurring transactions. Travel Bookings: Whether train, flight, bus, travel packages or more, you can make your travel-related bookings via UPI. QR Code Payments: You can scan merchant QR codes and pay using UPI linked to your RuPay Credit Card. The transaction amount will be deducted from your RuPay Credit Card’s credit limit and billed to you in the subsequent Credit Card statement. Note: Peer-to-peer (P2P), peer-to-peer merchant (P2M), cash withdrawal at ATMs or merchants, Mutual Funds payments, foreign inward remittances, payments on lending platforms, initial public offering (IPO) subscription and other such payments are not permitted on the UPI linked to the RuPay Credit Card. Credit Card Management & Controls Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Benefits of RuPay Credit Cards Reward Points With HDFC Bank RuPay Credit Cards, you can earn reward points on various types of expenses, including groceries, dining, and bill payments. Interest-Free Period HDFC Bank provides a 50-day interest-free period on your RuPay Credit Card purchases, allowing you to make payments within a specific timeframe without incurring interest charges. RuPay Credit Card Link with UPI RuPay Cards are enabled for UPI payments. You can easily link your RuPay Credit Card with various payment apps and use it to transact though UPI. To register for UPI, you need to set up your Credit Card PIN. Just dial 1860 266 0333. Here is how you can link RuPay Card with UPI: Download and open your preferred UPI-enabled app, such as PayZapp. Register your HDFC Bank UPI RuPay Credit Card within the app. Once registered, you can start making UPI payments using your Credit Card. How to link HDFC Bank RuPay Credit Card on PayZapp app? Existing PayZapp Users Follow these simple steps to link your RuPay Card with UPI: Choose 'RuPay Credit Card' and then select your Credit Card issuer to seamlessly link your RuPay Credit Card. Select 'UPI Accounts' and click on the '+ Add new' option. Log in to your PayZapp account and navigate to the 'Accounts & Cards' section. New PayZapp Users Follow the provided steps to get started with PayZapp and start using your RuPay Card for UPI payments. Download the PayZapp app from either the Google Play Store or the Apple App Store. Complete the PayZapp registration process. Head to ‘Accounts & Cards’ section and select '+ Add New’ option. Select ‘RuPay Credit Card' to set up your UPI. Choose the 'HDFC Bank Credit Card' to conveniently fetch and link your HDFC Bank RuPay Credit card. Set up your UPI PIN, by following these steps: Navigate to the PayZapp Home screen. Select 'Accounts & Cards,' then 'UPI Accounts.' Click on the 'Credit Cards' tab. Enter the last 6 digits of your card and its expiry date. Enter the One-Time Password (OTP). Enter your Credit Card PIN. Follow the prompts to set your UPI PIN. Making UPI payments with HDFC Bank RuPay Credit Card Launch your preferred UPI payment app such as PayZapp. Scan the UPI QR (Quick Response) code of the merchant or enter their details. Input the desired amount and choose your linked RuPay Credit Card. For enhanced convenience, opt for your HDFC Bank RuPay Credit Card account. Enter your UPI PIN to complete the payment. Get the payment confirmation receipt. UPI Transactions via RuPay Credit Card Only person to merchant (P2M) transactions are allowed when you use your RuPay Credit Card for UPI transactions: Online & Offline Shopping: You can make payments at online and offline retail stores, supermarkets, shopping malls, e-commerce websites. Utilities: Pay for services like electricity, gas, water, internet, etc., via UPI, using your RuPay Credit Card. Food Deliveries & Dining Out: You can pay food establishments or food delivery platforms for their services via UPI. Subscription Services: You can pay for multiple subscription services via UPI linked to your RuPay Credit Cards. Plus, you can also set up automatic payments for recurring transactions. Travel Bookings: Whether train, flight, bus, travel packages or more, you can make your travel-related bookings via UPI. QR Code Payments: You can scan merchant QR codes and pay using UPI linked to your RuPay Credit Card. The transaction amount will be deducted from your RuPay Credit Card’s credit limit and billed to you in the subsequent Credit Card statement. Note: Peer-to-peer (P2P), peer-to-peer merchant (P2M), cash withdrawal at ATMs or merchants, Mutual Funds payments, foreign inward remittances, payments on lending platforms, initial public offering (IPO) subscription and other such payments are not permitted on the UPI linked to the RuPay Credit Card. Benefits of UPI transaction through RuPay Credit Card Easy Bill Payments You can conveniently use your RuPay Credit Card for UPI transactions to pay bills, including utility bills, mobile recharge, and more. Earn Rewards By using your RuPay Credit Card for UPI payments, you can enjoy the convenience of UPI payments and earn rewards, such as cashback, reward points, or discounts. Credit Card Benefits UPI transactions made through your RuPay Credit Card enable you to enjoy card benefits, such as interest-free credit periods, lounge access and insurance coverage, depending on your card type. How Does a RuPay Card Work? A RuPay Credit Card operates seamlessly with a Chip+PIN technology. With the Credit Cards, you can pay for goods and services based on your promise to pay the bank for the utilised amount along with other charges. You can use the card for online purchases, shopping at POS, purchases on EMI and cash withdrawal from ATMs. Where are RuPay Credit Cards Accepted? RuPay Credit Cards are widely accepted in India for Point of Sale (PoS) transactions, ATM withdrawals, and e-commerce purchases. They can also be used for international transaction at PoS terminals, ATMs, and e-commerce websites that are enabled for Discover Financial Service (DFS). Clear All Compare Link to UPI & earn! evidence_data.value: Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Get the payment confirmation receipt.

evidence_data.value: Only person to merchant (P2M) transactions are allowed when you use your RuPay Credit Card for UPI transactions: Online & Offline Shopping: You can make payments at online and offline retail stores, supermarkets, shopping malls, e-commerce websites. Utilities: Pay for services like electricity, gas, water, internet, etc., via UPI, using your RuPay Credit Card. Food Deliveries & Dining Out: You can pay food establishments or food delivery platforms for their services via UPI. Subscription Services: You can pay for multiple subscription services via UPI linked to your RuPay Credit Cards. Plus, you can also set up automatic payments for recurring transactions. Travel Bookings: Whether train, flight, bus, travel packages or more, you can make your travel-related bookings via UPI. QR Code Payments: You can scan merchant QR codes and pay using UPI linked to your RuPay Credit Card. The transaction amount will be deducted from your RuPay Credit Card’s credit limit and billed to you in the subsequent Credit Card statement. Note: Peer-to-peer (P2P), peer-to-peer merchant (P2M), cash withdrawal at ATMs or merchants, Mutual Funds payments, foreign inward remittances, payments on lending platforms, initial public offering (IPO) subscription and other such payments are not permitted on the UPI linked to the RuPay Credit Card.

You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. IVR To enable or modify your HDFC Bank Credit Card controls and transaction limits, you can contact HDFC Bank's toll-free numbers: Toll-free numbers: 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available from 8 am to 8 pm) For overseas travel assistance: 022-61606160 By contacting our toll-free numbers, you can enable/modify limits for Domestic, International, Online, Contactless, ATM, and POS transactions on your Debit or Credit Card.

Revolving Credit is available at a nominal interest rate (Check the fees and charges section for more details). Get Up to 50 days of interest-free credit from the date of purchase. The offer is subject to the submission of the charge by the merchant. Stay protected against unauthorised use when you shop anywhere with EMV Chip Card technology.

Membership Renewal Fee: ₹1,000 + Applicable Taxes per year 1,000 Reward Points as Renewal Benefit every year On annual spends of ₹75,000 or more, get ₹1,000 renewal fee waived off on your HDFC Bank Superia Credit Card. An interest at the rate of 3.49% will be charged on any outstanding amount carried forward beyond the bill's due date. A 2.5% fee with a minimum of ₹500 will be applicable on all cash withdrawals from the card.

Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled.
