Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. evidence_data.value: Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. IVR To enable or modify your HDFC Bank Credit Card controls and transaction limits, you can contact HDFC Bank's toll-free numbers: Toll-free numbers: 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available from 8 am to 8 pm) For overseas travel assistance: 022-61606160 By contacting our toll-free numbers, you can enable/modify limits for Domestic, International, Online, Contactless, ATM, and POS transactions on your Debit or Credit Card.

Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. evidence_data.value: Lounge Access A. Domestic Lounge Access – VISA / RuPay Card W.e.f 10-Jun-2025, Domestic Lounge Access benefit will be Milestone based and can be availed as a Lounge Voucher on spends of Rs 50,000 or more in a calendar quarter. Please note, you can access 2 Complimentary Domestic Lounge Vouchers per calendar quarter (up to 8 per calendar year). Click Here for the list of eligible domestic lounge access. Upon qualifying for the benefit, you will receive SMS and Email, intimating you about the qualification. Please visit Claim Portal and login using your Bank registered mobile number and claim your lounge voucher within 120 days of qualification. Once you have claimed the voucher, you can use the voucher in the eligible lounge list within 180 days of issuance of the voucher, for more details Click here. You can also resend/view your claimed vouchers on Claim Portal. To check the spends and qualification status in the current calendar quarter, from 10-Jun-2025 you can login into HDFC Bank Netbanking/Mobilebanking app > Go to Credit Card Section > Select Tata Neu HDFC Bank Credit Card > Click on Redeem Reward Points (you will be re-directed to Rewards Portal) > In Rewards Portal Go to MyReward > Spend Promo Details. Note:- If your card is upgraded, lost, or reissued spends done on only new card will be considered. Spends done on previous card will not be considered for qualification. B. International Lounge Access – VISA Card W.e.f 01-Jun-2025, Priority Pass on Tata Neu Infinity HDFC Bank Credit Card- VISA will be issued only basis request. In case you have been issued a new/ renewed/ replacement card, then you can apply for Priority Pass for self and add-on members by calling HDFC Bank phonebanking toll-free numbers 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 to enjoy the international lounge access as per the product feature benefit. Using Priority Pass, you and your add on member can together avail up to 4 Complimentary Lounge Access per calendar year (1 per Quarter), outside India. If you exceed the 4 Complimentary (1 per Quarter) visits, you will be charged at US $27 + GST per visit All guests visits using Priority pass would be charged at US $27 + GST per visit per guest Please note: Priority Pass in India will attract charges on your Credit Card. Click here to know more. You can visit www.prioritypass.com for list of lounge details. To know about your lounge access history Please write a mail to pp@prioritypass.com.hk. Please provide name, complete 18 digit Priority Pass number and state that PP Membership is via HDFC Bank program. If there is more than 1 Priority Pass number (belonging to add-on PP holders), then please provide all the PP Numbers. C. International Lounge Access - RuPay 4 Complimentary Lounge Access per calendar year (1 per Quarter), outside India. Customers will be charged a transaction fee of $3.25 on their Credit card towards complimentary lounge access, same shall be reversed. Visit exceeding the complimentary quota will be allowed at the discretion of lounge and will also be chargeable by the lounge. Click here to check for list of RuPay International Lounges

evidence_data.value: Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. IVR To enable or modify your HDFC Bank Credit Card controls and transaction limits, you can contact HDFC Bank's toll-free numbers: Toll-free numbers: 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available from 8 am to 8 pm) For overseas travel assistance: 022-61606160 By contacting our toll-free numbers, you can enable/modify limits for Domestic, International, Online, Contactless, ATM, and POS transactions on your Debit or Credit Card.

Validity of Existing NeuCoins balance Non-Promotional NeuCoins: The validity of your existing balance of Non-Promotional NeuCoins (earned before 01-Aug-25) will be set as 31-Jul-26 in your Tata Neu Account, this activity will start from Jul’25 and will be completed by Aug’25 in a phased manner. Promotional NeuCoins/Welcome Benefit: NeuCoins earned during special promotions or as Welcome Benefit will continue to follow the expiry terms communicated at the time of issuance. For details on Redemption and Validity on NeuCoins, please click here

benefits.description: Tata Neu Plus Credit Card 2% back as NeuCoins on Tata Neu and partner Tata Brand Spends 1% back as NeuCoins on other Non-UPI spends Complimentary Domestic Airport Lounge Access*

Lounge Access Domestic Lounge Access benefit is Milestone based and can be availed as a Lounge Voucher on spends of Rs 50,000 or more in a calendar quarter. Please note, you can access 1 Complimentary Domestic Lounge Voucher per calendar quarter (up to 4 per calendar year).

Lounge Access Domestic Lounge Access – VISA / RuPay Card W.e.f 10-Jun-2025, Domestic Lounge Access benefit will be Milestone based and can be availed as a Lounge Voucher on spends of Rs 50,000 or more in a calendar quarter. Please note, you can access 1 Complimentary Domestic Lounge Vouchers per calendar quarter (up to 4 per calendar year). Click Here for the list of eligible domestic lounge access. Upon qualifying for the benefit, you will receive SMS and Email, intimating you about the qualification. Please visit Claim Portal and login using your Bank registered mobile number to claim your lounge voucher within 120 days of qualification.Once you have claimed the voucher, you can use the voucher in the eligible lounge list within 180 days of issuance of the voucher, for more details click here. You can also resend/view your claimed vouchers on Claim Portal. To check the spends and qualification status in the current calendar quarter, from 10-Jun-2025 you can login into HDFC Bank Netbanking/Mobilebanking app > Go to Credit Card Section > Select Tata Neu HDFC Bank Credit Card > Click on Redeem Reward Points (you will be re-directed to Rewards Portal) > In Rewards Portal Go to MyReward > Spend Promo Details. Note:- If your card is upgraded, lost, or reissued spends done on only new card will be considered. Spends done on previous card will not be considered for qualification.

Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. Travel Credit Cards offer various travel-related benefits and rewards, such as points, miles, or cashback, that can be earned and redeemed for travel expenses like flights, hotels, and more. What is the application process for a Travel Credit Card? Here is how to apply for an HDFC Bank Travel Credit Card: Explore card options by visiting HDFC Bank Credit Card webpage. Apply online with your mobile number and Permanent Account Number (PAN). Select the preferred card and submit the application. Our team will assess your application and issue the card. Are Travel Credit Cards lifetime free? Whether Travel Credit Cards are lifetime free or not varies by the specific card you choose. Some travel cards come with zero annual charges, especially in the first year as an introductory offer, while others may have annual fees. Therefore, always check the associated charges before applying for a travel Credit Card. Are travel cards worth getting? Travel Credit Cards can offer significant savings on travel expenses and enhance your travel experiences. It is important to assess how well you can utilise the card and its benefits to determine its worthiness. What is the difference between a Travel Credit Card and a Credit Card? Travel Credit Cards are specifically designed for travellers and offer benefits like travel rewards, airport lounge access, and travel insurance. Ordinary Credit Cards are more general-purpose financial tools that do not provide these travel-specific advantages. Why is a travel card better? A Travel Credit Card can be better for those who travel frequently because it offers a range of travel-related benefits and rewards. These cards can help you save on travel expenses and provide valuable benefits such as airport and train lounge access, exclusive discount on brands, complimentary stays and offers on travel bookings. These rewards can be redeemed for various travel-related expenses, such as flights and hotels. Read More Welcome Bonuses and Sign-Up Incentive HDFC Bank Travel Credit Cards involve earning a substantial number of points or miles when you meet specific spending requirements within the initial months of card ownership to help you enhance your savings. Read More Exclusive Partner Discounts HDFC Bank partners with airlines, hotels, and travel companies to offer exclusive discounts and privileges to cardholders. These partnerships can lead to significant savings on your travel expenses. Read More HDFC Bank SmartEMI HDFC Bank Travel Credit Cards offer Smart EMI (Equated Monthly Instalments) facilities for your travel expenses. Travel Credit Cards offer various travel-related benefits and rewards, such as points, miles, or cashback, that can be earned and redeemed for travel expenses like flights, hotels, and more. What is the application process for a Travel Credit Card? Here is how to apply for an HDFC Bank Travel Credit Card: Explore card options by visiting HDFC Bank Credit Card webpage. Apply online with your mobile number and Permanent Account Number (PAN). Select the preferred card and submit the application. Our team will assess your application and issue the card. Are Travel Credit Cards lifetime free? Whether Travel Credit Cards are lifetime free or not varies by the specific card you choose. Some travel cards come with zero annual charges, especially in the first year as an introductory offer, while others may have annual fees. Therefore, always check the associated charges before applying for a travel Credit Card. Are travel cards worth getting? Travel Credit Cards can offer significant savings on travel expenses and enhance your travel experiences. It is important to assess how well you can utilise the card and its benefits to determine its worthiness. What is the difference between a Travel Credit Card and a Credit Card? Travel Credit Cards are specifically designed for travellers and offer benefits like travel rewards, airport lounge access, and travel insurance. Ordinary Credit Cards are more general-purpose financial tools that do not provide these travel-specific advantages. Why is a travel card better? A Travel Credit Card can be better for those who travel frequently because it offers a range of travel-related benefits and rewards. These cards can help you save on travel expenses and provide valuable benefits such as airport and train lounge access, exclusive discount on brands, complimentary stays and offers on travel bookings. These rewards can be redeemed for various travel-related expenses, such as flights and hotels. Read More Welcome Bonuses and Sign-Up Incentive HDFC Bank Travel Credit Cards involve earning a substantial number of points or miles when you meet specific spending requirements within the initial months of card ownership to help you enhance your savings. Read More Exclusive Partner Discounts HDFC Bank partners with airlines, hotels, and travel companies to offer exclusive discounts and privileges to cardholders. These partnerships can lead to significant savings on your travel expenses. Read More HDFC Bank SmartEMI HDFC Bank Travel Credit Cards offer Smart EMI (Equated Monthly Instalments) facilities for your travel expenses. Travel Credit Cards offer various travel-related benefits and rewards, such as points, miles, or cashback, that can be earned and redeemed for travel expenses like flights, hotels, and more. What is the application process for a Travel Credit Card? Here is how to apply for an HDFC Bank Travel Credit Card: Explore card options by visiting HDFC Bank Credit Card webpage. Apply online with your mobile number and Permanent Account Number (PAN). Select the preferred card and submit the application. Our team will assess your application and issue the card. Are Travel Credit Cards lifetime free? Whether Travel Credit Cards are lifetime free or not varies by the specific card you choose. Some travel cards come with zero annual charges, especially in the first year as an introductory offer, while others may have annual fees. Therefore, always check the associated charges before applying for a travel Credit Card. Are travel cards worth getting? Travel Credit Cards can offer significant savings on travel expenses and enhance your travel experiences. It is important to assess how well you can utilise the card and its benefits to determine its worthiness. What is the difference between a Travel Credit Card and a Credit Card? Travel Credit Cards are specifically designed for travellers and offer benefits like travel rewards, airport lounge access, and travel insurance. Ordinary Credit Cards are more general-purpose financial tools that do not provide these travel-specific advantages. Why is a travel card better? A Travel Credit Card can be better for those who travel frequently because it offers a range of travel-related benefits and rewards. These cards can help you save on travel expenses and provide valuable benefits such as airport and train lounge access, exclusive discount on brands, complimentary stays and offers on travel bookings. Netbanking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through NetBanking, follow these steps: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID. 2. Go to the Cards Tab >Select the card > Click Manage card>Manage Domestic and International Limits. 3. You will be able to view your existing daily domestic and international usage limits. 4. Enable or disable Online, Contactless, and International usage based on your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’, enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number, and then click ‘Continue’. 6. Your selected card controls will be updated instantly. Mobile Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card conveniently through our HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, follow these steps: 1. Open the HDFC Bank MobileBanking App and log in using your credentials. 2. Go to the ‘Cards’ section from the menu. 3. Select the HDFC Bank Credit Card for which you want to enable card controls. 4. Click ‘Manage Limits’, then enable/disable transaction types such as Online Transactions, Contactless Payments, and International Usage, or set transaction limits according to your preference. 5. Click ‘Update’ to confirm your changes and enter your MPIN. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. For more detailed management, you can also use our MyCards platform at https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ which offers a seamless experience without the need for passwords or downloads. MyCards To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card via MyCards, follow these steps: 1. Visit the MyCards portal- https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/ on your desktop or mobile. 2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received. 3. For first-time users, enter the last four digits of your card. 4. On the card homepage, click the ‘Card Control’ tab. 5. Enable/disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, International Usage, and set usage limits as per your preference. 6. Confirm your settings, and the changes will be applied instantly. PayZapp You can conveniently enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card through PayZapp by following these steps: 1. Open the PayZapp app and log in using your credentials. 2. On the homepage, tap the ‘MyCards’ tab> Select ‘Go to MyCards’. 3. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP sent to your mobile. 4. If you are a first-time user, enter the last four digits of your HDFC Bank Credit Card. 5. On the card homepage, tap the ‘Card Control’ tab. 6. Enable or disable features such as Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, and International Usage, or set usage limits according to your preference. 7. Confirm your settings. The updated card control settings will be applied instantly. WhatsApp Banking To enable card controls for your HDFC Bank Credit Card using WhatsApp Banking, follow the steps given below: 1. Add HDFC Bank’s official WhatsApp number – 7070022222– to your contacts. 2. Send the text "Credit Card" to this number. 3. You will receive a reply with options. Choose the option “Manage My Card” 4. You will receive a reply with options to select “Domestic / International/ Enhance limits” 5. Choose the option you want to enable, such as Domestic Online Transactions, Contactless Transactions, or International Transactions. 6. Enter the transaction limit you want to set. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to confirm the change. 7. Enter the last 4 digits of your Credit Card number. 8. The current status of the selected transaction type will be shown as Enabled. IVR To enable or modify your HDFC Bank Credit Card controls and transaction limits, you can contact HDFC Bank's toll-free numbers: Toll-free numbers: 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available from 8 am to 8 pm) For overseas travel assistance: 022-61606160 By contacting our toll-free numbers, you can enable/modify limits for Domestic, International, Online, Contactless, ATM, and POS transactions on your Debit or Credit Card.

Titanium Edge Credit Card Fees & Charges Annual fee: Membership renewal fee waiver on spending ₹50,000 within a year. Cash advance fee of 2.5%, with a minimum of ₹500, is applied to all cash withdrawals. Interest: 3.49% interest per month on any unpaid balance carried past the due date of the bill. Check Now

Revolving Credit is available at a nominal interest rate. (Check the ​fees and charges section for more details). Get Up to 50 days of interest-free credit from the date of purchase. The offer is subject to submission of the charge by the merchant. Stay protected against unauthorised use when you shop anywhere with EMV Chip Card technology. Zero liability for fraudulent transactions if reported immediately to HDFC Bank’s 24/7 Call Centre

Link your HDFC Bank Titanium Edge Credit Card on PayZapp Extra CashBack and Reward Points on utility bills, mobile recharge and more. Get ₹1,000 CashBack on shopping in-app over 200+ brands. Securely pay without the hassle of OTPs with ‘Swipe to Pay’.

The Titanium Edge Credit Card is enabled* for Contactless Payments at retail outlets. *Note: In India, contactless payments up to ₹5,000 don't require a PIN for a single transaction. For amounts of ₹5,000 or more, the Cardholder must enter the Credit Card PIN. You may check for the Contactless Network Symbol on your card.

Joining Fee and Annual Fee The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee. Interest Charge Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month. Late Payment Fee If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged. Over-the-Limit Fee You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit. GST Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%. To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions). Tips for secure Credit Card usage Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies Never save your Card information on any websites Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan. Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for. Do's Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap. Don’ts Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone Don't exceed your credit limit Don't make late payments. How can I update insurance nominee details? Click here to update your Nominee details. FAQs on Credit Card What is a Credit Card? A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges. What is the limit of a Credit Card? A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history. What is Credit Card balance? Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal. Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions? Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking. How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card? To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, click here . What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card? The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000
